harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: «رجلين»: a badal (substitute) of «مثلا»; the clause «أحدهما أبكم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رجلين». The clause «لا يقدر» is a second khabar (predicate) of «أحدهما»; the clause «وهو كَلٌّ» is conjoined to the clause «لا يقدر»; and the conditional clause is a second khabar of «هو». His words «أينما»: a jussive conditional noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يوجِّهه». The clause «هل يستوي» is resumptive. His words «هو»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in يستوي; «مَنْ» is a relative noun conjoined to the latent pronoun, the conjoining being licensed by the separation by the pronoun. The clause «وهو على صراط» is conjoined to the clause of the ṣila (relative clause).

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: The clause «وما أَمْرُ الساعة ... » is conjoined to the resumptive «ولله غيب». The preposition «كلمح» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the clause «أو هو أقرب» is conjoined to the implied khabar «كائن», as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The clause «لا تعلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf in «أخرجكم». The clause «لعلكم تشكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: «مسخَّرات»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الطير»; the preposition «في جو» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مسخرات»; the clause «ما يمسكهن» is a second ḥāl of «الطير»; and the clause «يؤمنون» is a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: The preposition «من بيوتكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سكنا»; the preposition «من جلود» is attached to a ḥāl of «بيوتا»; and the clause «تستخفونها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بيوتا». The preposition «من أصوافها» is conjoined to «من جلود» and is attached to what that is attached to, i.e.: وجعل لكم من أصوافها أثاثا; on this view a genitive has been conjoined to a genitive and an accusative to an accusative. The preposition «إلى حين» is attached to a naʿt of «متاعا».

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ظلالا». «ظلالا» is the object of «جعل»; «الحر» is a second object. The clause «تقيكم» is a naʿt (adjective). «كذلك»: the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi, i.e.: He completes His favour with a completing like that completing. The clause «لعلكم تسلمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The clause «فإن تولَّوا» is conjoined to the clause {يُتِمُّ}; «البلاغ» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The clause «يعرفون» is resumptive, and the clause «وأكثرهم الكافرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «ينكرونها».

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: His words «ويوم»: the wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر» (remember), and the implied clause is resumptive. The preposition «للذين» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause «ولا هم يستعتبون» is conjoined to the clause «يؤذن».

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: «إذا»: a conditional adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the apodosis. The clause «فلا يخفف» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: هو, referring back to «العذاب». The clause «فهو لا يخفف» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause «ولا هم ينظرون» is conjoined to the clause «فهو لا يخفف», in the position of the jussive. We implied the fāʾ as entering on «هو» because an imperfect verb joined with «لا» does not take the fāʾ of the apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause. «الذين كنا»: the relative noun is a naʿt (adjective). The preposition «من دونك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied object of «ندعو», i.e.: ندعوهم كائنين من دونك (we call on them, being other than You). The clause «فألقوا» is resumptive; it is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a ḍamma implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. The clause «إنكم لكاذبون» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl) by the maṣdar (verbal noun) «القول», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: The clause «وألقوا» is conjoined to the preceding clause «ألقوا»; «يومئذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ألقوا»; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the tanwīn is in compensation for a clause. His words «ما يفترون»: a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of «ضلَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: «الذين كفروا» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «زدناهم» is the khabar (predicate). The adverb «فوق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عذابا». His words «بما»: «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to «زدناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: His words «ويوم نبعث»: the wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر»; «شهيدا» is a mafʿūl bihi, and the two preposition and its genitive nouns after it are attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; the second «شهيدا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf; «تبيانا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the preposition «لكل» is attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) «تبيانا»; and the preposition «للمسلمين» is attached to «بشرى».

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The clause «يعظكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «ينهى», in the position of the accusative; the clause «لعلكم تذكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: «إذا»: a conditional adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the implied apodosis, i.e.: يلزم وفاؤكم إذا عاهدتم (your fulfilment is binding when you make a covenant). The clause «عاهدتم» is muḍāf ilayhi; the conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «وقد جعلتم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تنقضوا», and «كفيلا» is the second object of «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: «أنكاثا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «غَزْلها»; «دخلا» is a second object; the clause «تتخذون» is a ḥāl of the pronoun of «يكونوا»; «بينكم» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «دخلا»; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: مخافةَ (for fear that). The clause «هي أربى» is the khabar (predicate) of كان. The clause «وليبيننَّ» is the apodosis of an implied oath, and the oath with its apodosis is a resumptive clause.

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «ولكن يضل» is conjoined to the resumptive one. His words «ولتسألُن»: the wāw is a conjunction; an imperfect passive verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause «ولتسألن» is conjoined to the conditional clause, and it is composed of the oath and its apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: «دخَلا»: a second object, and the adverb «بينكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «دخلا». His words «فَتَزِلَّ»: the fāʾ is causal; an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: لا يكن منكم اتخاذ أيمان فَزَلَل قدم (let there not be from you a taking of oaths and then a slipping of a foot). His words «بما صددتم»: the bāʾ is a preposition, «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive maṣdar is attached to «تذوقوا». The clause «ولكم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «تذوقوا», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: «إن» is abrogating; «ما» is a relative noun, its noun; the adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); the clause «هو خير» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن». The clause «إن كنتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: «ما»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the adverb «عندكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); and the clause «ينفد» is the khabar (predicate) of «ما». His words «باقٍ»: a nominative khabar of the relative «ما», nominative with a ḍamma implied on the dropped yāʾ. His words «أجرهم»: a second object. «ما كانوا»: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: «مَنْ»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «من ذكر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «عمل», and the clause «وهو مؤمن» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil of «عمل». His words «فلنحيينَّه»: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), the lām occurs in the apodosis of the oath, and the clause is the apodosis of the oath; the oath with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being نحن. «حياة» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «إذا»: a conditional adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the apodosis, i.e.: تلزمك الاستعاذة إذا قرأت (seeking refuge is binding on you when you recite).

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The clause «ليس له سلطان» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ»; the clause «يتوكلون» is conjoined to the clause آمنوا.

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: «إنما»: the restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The preposition «به» is attached to the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: «إذا»: a conditional adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis; «مكان» is an adverb of place attached to «بدَّلنا»; the clause «والله أعلم» is parenthetical; «مفترٍ» is a nominative khabar (predicate), with a ḍamma implied on the dropped yāʾ; and the clause «بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: The preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «نزله». His words «وهدى»: a noun conjoined to the preceding genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: للتثبيت وهدى (for making firm, and as guidance).

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنهم يقولون» stands in place of the two objects of «علم»; the clause «لسان الذي يلحدون..» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: The clause «ولهم عذاب أليم» is conjoined to the clause «لا يهديهم الله».

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: «الذين»: a postponed fāʿil (agent). The clause «أولئك هم الكاذبون» is conjoined to the resumptive one, and «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: «مَنْ»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and its apodosis is implied, i.e.: فعليهم غضب; what comes after the second «من» indicates the apodosis. «إلا» is for exception; مَنْ is a relative noun, the excepted (mustathnā); and the clause «وقلبه مطمئن» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nāʾib [fāʿil] of «أُكْرِهَ» [Translator's note: the source says «فاعل» (agent) of the passive «أُكْرِهَ»]. The clause «ولكن من شرح» is conjoined to the resumptive «من كفر»; «صدرا» is a tamyīz (specification), and «شرح» is made to contain the sense of طاب (to be pleased). His words «فعليهم»: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), by likening the relative noun to the conditional, since «مَن» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the clause «فعليهم غضب» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «مَنْ». The clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «فعليهم غضب».

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «بأنهم استحبوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the second maṣdar is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: His words «أولئك الذين»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); and «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: «لا جرم»: «لا» is the lā of generic negation with its noun; its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: موجود (existing); and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition (في). «هم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and «الخاسرون» its khabar, and the clause is the khabar of «أن». The preposition «في الآخرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «الخاسرون».

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: The clause «ثم إن ربك ... » is conjoined to the clause {لا جَرَمَ}. The preposition «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «إن», in the sense: He is their helper, not their forsaker. «ما» in His words «ما فتنوا» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi. The preposition «من بعدها» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ربك». The clause «إن ربك لغفور» is resumptive, emphasising the first clause.

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: «يوم»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «اذكر» (remember), and the clause «اذكر» is resumptive. The clause «تأتي» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «تجادل» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «كل», the ḥāl from an indefinite being permitted because it is in construct. His words «ما عملت»: a noun, second object. The clause «وهم لا يظلمون» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «عملت», put in the plural according to the sense.

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: «قرية»: a badal (substitute); the clause «كانت» is a naʿt (adjective); «مطمئنة» is a second khabar (predicate); the clause «يأتيها رزقها» is a third khabar of «كان»; «رغدا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «رزقها»; and «لباس» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:113-113.t: The clause «ولقد جاءهم رسول» is resumptive, and the clause «لقد جاءهم» is the apodosis of the oath. The clause «وهم ظالمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «أخذهم».

harrat-mujtaba:114-114.t: The clause «فكلوا» is resumptive; the preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «حلالا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), originally an adjective of an omitted qualified noun, i.e.: طعاما حلالا (lawful food). «إياه» is a detached accusative pronoun, a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is for the third person. The conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «تعبدون» is the khabar (predicate) of كان.

harrat-mujtaba:115-115.t: His words «وما أُهِل»: a relative noun conjoined to «لحم». His words «فمن اضطر»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «مَن» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the pronoun "he" (هو); «غير» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «اضطر»; «عادٍ» is conjoined to «باغ». The clause «فمن اضطر» is conjoined to the resumptive «إنما حرَّم», and the clause «اضطر» is the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:116-116.t: «لما»: the lām is a preposition and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and «الكذب» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «تصف». Its meaning is: do not declare things unlawful or lawful because of a statement your tongues utter without proof. The clause «هذا حلال» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl), and the interpreted maṣdar «لتفتروا» is a badal (substitute) of the preceding maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:117-117.t: «متاع»: the khabar (predicate) of an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: عيشهم (their living). The clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «عيشهم متاع».

harrat-mujtaba:118-118.t: The clause «حرَّمنا» is resumptive; the clause «وما ظلمناهم» is conjoined to the clause «حرَّمْنا»; and the clause «كانوا» is conjoined to «ظلمناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:119-119.t: The clause «ثم إن ربك» is conjoined to the earlier clause {حَرَّمْنَا}. The preposition «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the preposition «بجهالة» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «عملوا»; the preposition «من بعدها» is attached to a ḥāl of «ربك»; and the clause «إن ربك لغفور» is resumptive, emphasising the first.

harrat-mujtaba:120-120.t: «قانتا لله حنيفا»: two khabars (predicates) of كان, and the preposition «لله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قانتا». The clause «ولم يك» is conjoined to the clause «كان أمة». His words «لم يك»: an abrogating imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with a sukūn implied on the nūn, which was dropped for lightening; its noun is the pronoun "he" (هو).

harrat-mujtaba:121-121.t: «شاكرا»: a fourth khabar (predicate) of «كان», and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شاكرا». The clause «اجتباه» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:122-122.t: The preposition «في الآخرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «الصالحين»; the clause «وإنه لمن الصالحين» is conjoined to the clause «آتيناه», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:123-123.t: «أنْ» is explicative (mufassira), and the clause after it is explicative. «حنيفا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «إبراهيم»; the ḥāl from the muḍāf ilayhi is permitted because the muḍāf is like a part of the muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «وما كان» is conjoined to the ḥāl «حنيفا», as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word.

harrat-mujtaba:124-124.t: The two adverbs «بينهم» and «يوم» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the preposition «فيه» is attached to «يختلفون».

harrat-mujtaba:125-125.t: The clause «هو أعلم» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the preposition «بالمهتدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:126-126.t: His words «ولئن»: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa), and «إن» is conditional. The lām in His words «لهو» occurs in the apodosis of the oath. The preposition «للصابرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير». The clause «ولئن صبرتم» is conjoined to the clause «إن عاقبتم»; the clause «لهو خير» is the apodosis of the oath, and the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the apodosis of the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:127-127.t: The clause «وما صبرك إلا بالله» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «اصبر»; the preposition «بالله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «صبرك»; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). «تكُ» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with a sukūn implied on the nūn, which was dropped for lightening. His words «مما» are composed of the preposition «مِن» and the maṣdariyya «ما», and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to «ضيق».

harrat-mujtaba:128-128.t: «مع»: an adverb of place for accompaniment, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The clause «فلا تستعجلوه» is conjoined to the clause «أتى أمر»; conjoining a performative (inshāʾ) clause to an informative (khabar) one is permitted. The clause «سبحانه» is resumptive; it is a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of an omitted governing verb, its implied form being «نسبح». The clause «وتعالى» is conjoined to the resumptive «سبحانه». «ما» in «عمَّا» is maṣdar-forming, and the maṣdar is genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تعالى».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «بالروح» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الملائكة», i.e. "accompanied", and the preposition and its genitive noun «من أمره» is attached to a ḥāl from «الروح». «أن» is explicative, and the clause after it is explicative. The clause of tanzīh (declaring Allah's oneness) «لا إله إلا أنا» is the khabar (predicate) of «أن»; «لا» is the lā of generic negation, «إله» is its noun, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being «مستحق للعبادة»; «إلا» is for restriction, and «أنا» is a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar. The interpreted maṣdar is the object of the warning. The clause «فاتقون» is conjoined to the clause of tanzīh; the yāʾ of the verb in «اتقون» was dropped for lightness, the kasra sufficing in its place.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خلق», and «ما» in «عما» is maṣdar-forming.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «فإذا هو خصيم»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya), then a mubtadaʾ (subject), and its two khabars (predicates) are «خصيم مبين». The clause is conjoined to the resumptive clause «خلق».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «والأنعام»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «وخلق». The clause «وخلق الأنعام» is conjoined to the clause {خَلَقَ الإِنْسَانَ}, and the clause «خلقها» is explicative of the implied verb. The clause «لكم فيها دفء» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «خلقها»; the preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from «دفء». The clause «ومنها تأكلون» is conjoined to the clause «لكم فيها دفء».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «جمال»; «جمال» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «تريحون» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «وتحمل» is conjoined to the clause {وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ}, and the clause «لم تكونوا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بلد». The preposition and its genitive noun «بشق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «بالغيه», i.e. "you would not reach it except while beset with hardship".

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «والخيل»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الأنعام» in verse (5). «لتركبوها»: accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن», and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb «خلق». «وزينة»: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The verb reaches the first by means of the lām in «لتركبوها» and reaches «زينة» by itself only because a condition is lacking in the first, namely the non-identity of the agent: the Creator is Allah while the riders are those addressed, unlike the second. The clause «ويخلق» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «ومنها جائر» is parenthetical, and the clause «ولو شاء لهداكم» is conjoined to the resumptive «وعلى الله قصد». «أجمعين» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «لكم منه شراب» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ماء», and the clause «ومنه شجر» is conjoined to the clause «لكم منه شراب»; the clause «تسيمون» is a naʿt of «شجر». The preposition and its genitive noun «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شراب»; the clause «تسيمون» is a naʿt of «شجر»; the preposition and its genitive noun «فيه» is attached to «تسيمون».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «ومن كل»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "and something of every…". The clause «يتفكرون» is a naʿt of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «والنجوم مُسَخَّرات» is conjoined to the clause «سخَّر», with no grammatical position. The preposition and its genitive noun «بأمره» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مسخرات», and the clause «يعقلون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: «وما ذرأ»: a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «القمر», and the two preposition and its genitive nouns are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ذرأ». «مختلفًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما», and «ألوانه» is the fāʿil (agent) of «مختلفا».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is conjoined to the clause {هُوَ الَّذِي} in verse (10). The clause «تَلْبَسُونَهَا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حِلْيَةً», and the clause «وترى» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements. The maṣdar «ولتبتغوا» is conjoined to the clause «لتأكلوا», and the clause «ولعلكم تشكرون» is conjoined to the single word, the "seeking".

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The maṣdar «أن تميد» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of aversion that…". The clause «لعلكم تهتدون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «وعلامات» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «سبلا», and the clause «هم يهتدون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «أفمن يخلق» is resumptive; «مَنْ» is a relative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun «كمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «أفلا تذكَّرون» is conjoined to the resumptive «أفمن يخلق».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «وإن تعدوا» is resumptive; «رحيم» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «والذين يدعون» is resumptive. The preposition and its genitive noun «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied pronoun referring to the relative. The clause «لا يخلقون» is the khabar (predicate), and the clause «وهم يُخْلَقون» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «يَخْلقون».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «أموات» is a second khabar (predicate) of «هم», and «غير» a third khabar. «أيَّان» is an interrogative noun, an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يبعثون». The clause «يبعثون» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يشعرون», whose operation is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, it having taken on the meaning of a transitive verb of the heart. The clause «وما يشعرون» is conjoined to the clause {يَخْلُقُونَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «واحد» is a naʿt (adjective). The clause «فالذين لا يؤمنون» is resumptive; «قلوبهم» is a second mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «قلوبهم منكرة» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين». The clause «وهم مستكبرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «قلوبهم».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: «لا جرم»: «لا» is the lā of generic negation, «جرم» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being «موجود». The interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition (في).

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: (وإذا قيل لهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «قيل» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is the pronoun of the maṣdar. «ماذا»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» is a relative noun, the khabar (predicate). «أساطير» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «هي», and the clause «هي أساطير» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The interpreted maṣdar «ليحملوا» is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) {قَالُوا}. «كاملة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أوزارهم», and «يوم» is an adverb attached to «يحملوا». «ومن أوزار»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun conjoined to «أوزارهم», the implied form being: "and burdens being of the burdens". The preposition and its genitive noun «بغير» is attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «يضلون». «ألا»: a particle of opening (istiftāḥ) and drawing attention; «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil of «ساء», and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "their load"; the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «قد مكر» is resumptive, and the clause «فأتى» is conjoined to the resumptive one. The preposition and its genitive noun «من القواعد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أتى»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من فوقهم» is attached to «خرَّ». The clause «لا يشعرون» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يخزيهم». «أين»: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, an adverb of place attached to the khabar (predicate); «شركائي» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective). «اليوم» is an adverb attached to the notion of "being settled" (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of {الْكَافِرِينَ}; «ظالمي» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «تتوفَّاهم». The clause «فألقوا السلم» is conjoined to the clause «تتوفاهم», and the clause «ما كنا» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied saying, the saying being accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "they offered submission, saying". «من سوء»: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «إن الله عليم» is the content of an implied saying, in the position of an accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «فادخلوا» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). «خالدين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدين». «فلبئس»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the lām in «لبئس» falls in the answer to an omitted oath, the implied form being: "so by Allah, how evil is the abode". The clause «فوالله لبئس مثوى» is resumptive, and the clause «لبئس مثوى» is the answer to the oath; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. «جهنم».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «وقيل» is resumptive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the pronoun of the maṣdar of «قيل». «ماذا»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the relative «ذا» is the khabar (predicate). «خيرا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied «أنزل», and the clause «أنزل خيرا» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). The preposition and its genitive noun «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun «في هذه» is attached to «أحسنوا». The clause «ولدار الآخرة خير» is resumptive. The lām in «لنعم» falls in the answer to an omitted oath, the implied form being: "and by Allah, how excellent is the abode"; the clause «ووالله لنعم دار» is resumptive, and the clause «لنعم دار» is the answer to the oath; the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, i.e. «دار الآخرة».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «جنات»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are gardens", and the clause «هي جنات» is explicative of the preceding praise. The clause «يدخلونها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جنات», and the clause «تجري» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the third-person pronoun in «يدخلونها»; the clause «لهم فيها ما يشاءون» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «يدخلونها». «كذلك»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "Allah recompenses with a recompense like that recompense"; the clause «يجزي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «المتقين», and «طيبين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ. «سلام» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); beginning with an indefinite is permitted because it is a supplication. The clause «يقولون» is a ḥāl from «الملائكة», and the clause «ادخلوا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «هل ينظرون» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar is the object of «ينظرون». «كذلك»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the implied form being: "those before them did a doing like that doing". The clause «فعل» is resumptive, and the clause «وما ظلمهم الله» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, because the following clause {فَأَصَابَهُمْ} is conjoined to the clause «فعل». The clause «ولكن كانوا» is conjoined to the clause «ما ظلمهم الله». «أنفسهم»: a fronted object of the verb «يظلمون», and the clause «يظلمون» is the khabar (predicate) of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: «ما عملوا»: «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «ما كانوا»: a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of «حاق».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «وقال الذين» is resumptive. The preposition and its genitive noun «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شيء»; «شيء» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). «نحن» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the nominative pronoun in «عبدنا»; «لا» is redundant, to emphasize the negation; «آباؤنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the pronoun «نا»; conjoining an overt noun to an attached nominative pronoun is permitted because of the separating element between them. «ولا حَرَّمنا من دونه من شيء» is like what precedes it. The clause «فعل» is resumptive. «فهل على الرسل»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «البلاغ», which is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «إلا» is for restriction, and the clause is resumptive.

mekki-muskil:1-1.t: His saying, the Exalted, {أَتَى أَمر الله}: it means "the command of Allah will come". The past form is good in place of the future because of the certainty of the coming of the command; so, in that it must inevitably come, it became like what has already passed and happened, and reporting it with the past was good. This occurs most often in what Allah, exalted be His mention, informs us will happen: because of the soundness of its occurrence and the truthfulness of the one reporting it, it has become as though it were something that has already happened.

mekki-muskil:15-15.t: His saying {أَن تميد بكم}: أن is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). It has also been said its implied form is "out of aversion to its shaking (كَرَاهَة أَن تميد)", and it has also been said its meaning is "lest it shake (لِئَلَّا تميد)".

mekki-muskil:2-2.t: His saying {أَن أنذروا}: أن is in the position of genitive as a badal (substitute) from الروح — and الروح here is the revelation — or in the position of accusative on the dropping of the preposition, i.e. "with [the message] that: warn (بِأَن أنذروا)".

mekki-muskil:30-30.t:
His saying {مَاذَا أنزل ربكُم}: مَا is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); it is an interrogative whose meaning is affirmation (taqrīr). ذا means الذي and is the khabar (predicate) of مَا, and أنزل ربكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ذا; with أنزل there is an omitted hāʾ referring to ذا, its implied form being "what is it that your Lord sent down (مَا الَّذِي أنزلهُ ربكُم)". Since the question was nominative, the answer ran accordingly, so أساطير الأولين is nominative, also as [part of] a mubtadaʾ and khabar, its implied form being "they said: it is the tales of the ancients".
As for the second, مَا and ذا are a single noun in the position of accusative by أنزل, and مَا is again interrogative; since the question was accusative, the answer ran accordingly, so He said قَالُوا خيرا, i.e. "He sent down good".

mekki-muskil:32-32.t: His saying {طيبين}: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ and mīm in تتوفاهم.

mekki-muskil:40-40.t:
His saying {كن فَيكون}: Ibn ʿĀmir and al-Kisāʾī read فيكون in the accusative, by conjunction to أن نقول [Translator's note: the text has أن تقول]. Whoever puts it in the nominative cuts it off from what precedes, i.e. "then it is"; what follows the fāʾ is resumed. The accusative as the answer to كن is far-fetched, because its wording is the wording of a command while its meaning is a report about the power of Allah, since there is no one there commanded to do anything; so the meaning is "We only say to it: Be, and it is". Its like in having the form of a command while not being a command is His saying, the Exalted, أسمع بِهِ وَأبْصر: its wording is the wording of a command and its meaning is wonder (taʿajjub). Since the meaning of كن is a report, it is far-fetched that فيكون should be an answer to it and be made accusative on that basis.
It is also far-fetched from another aspect: the answer to a command is made jussive only because it carries the meaning of a condition. When you say قُم أكرمك ("stand, I will honour you"), you make the answer jussive because it means "if you stand, I will honour you"; likewise when you say قُم فأكرمك, you make it accusative only because it means "if you stand, then I will honour you". This always occurs only with two verbs differing in wording and differing in agents. If they agree in wording and the agent is one, it is not permissible, because it has no meaning: if you said قُم تقم, قم فتقوم, اخرج فتخرج ("stand and you will stand", "go out and you will go out"), it would have no meaning, just as if you said "if you go out you will go out" or "if you stand then you will stand", it would have no meaning, because the two verbs and the two agents agree. Likewise كن فيكون: since the wording of the two verbs agrees and the agent is one, it is not good for فيكون to be an answer to the first. The accusative as an answer is permissible only remotely, by likening كن to a genuine command and likening [the two] to two differing verbs.
Al-Akhfash permitted, in His saying, the Exalted, قل لعبادي الَّذين آمنُوا يقيموا, that يقيموا be an answer to قل, though it is not truly an answer to it, because Allah the Exalted's command to His Prophet, peace be upon him, to speak does not contain an explicit command to them to establish the prayer, until he says to them: "Establish the prayer". So the accusative of فيكون as the answer to كن is permissible only by way of likening, as we have mentioned, and it is far-fetched because of the corruption of the meaning; al-Zajjāj permitted it. On this basis Ibn ʿĀmir read the accusative in Sūrat al-Baqara, Āl ʿImrān and Ghāfir. As for this sūra and Yā Sīn, the accusative is good, by conjunction to نقول, because أن precedes it.

mekki-muskil:42-42.t: His saying {الَّذين صَبَرُوا}: الذين is in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) from الذين هاجروا, or in the position of accusative as a badal from the hāʾ and mīm in لنبوئنهم, or on the implication of أعني ("I mean").

mekki-muskil:51-51.t: His saying {إِلَهَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ}: اثنين is a tawkīd (emphasis), in the same position as واحد in His saying, the Exalted, إِنَّمَا الله اله وَاحِد.

mekki-muskil:52-52.t: His saying {الدّين واصبا}: [واصبا is] accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

mekki-muskil:57-57.t: His saying {وَلَهُم مَا يشتهون}: مَا is nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) and لهم is the khabar (predicate). Al-Farrāʾ permitted مَا to be in the position of accusative on the implied form "and they assign to themselves what they desire (ويجعلون لَهُم مَا يشتهون)". This is not permissible according to the Basrans, just as جعلت لي طَعَاما ("I made food for me") is not permissible; only جعلت لنَفْسي طَعَاما ("I made food for myself") is permissible. Had the wording of the Quran been ولأنفسهم مَا يشتهون, what al-Farrāʾ said would be permissible according to the Basrans. This is a principle that needs justification and much elaboration.

mekki-muskil:58-58.t: His saying {ظلّ وَجهه مسودا}: وجهه is the noun of ظلّ and مسودا is the khabar (predicate). In speech it is permissible to imply the noun of ظلّ in it and put وجهه and مسودا in the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, with the clause as the khabar of ظلّ.

mekki-muskil:62-62.t:
His saying {وتصف ألسنتهم الْكَذِب}: اللسان ("tongue") is masculine and feminine. Whoever makes it feminine says in its plural ألسُن, and whoever makes it masculine says in its plural ألسنة, and so the Quran came. الكذب is accusative by تصف, and أن لهم is a badal (substitute) from الكذب, the substitution of a thing for a thing that is identical to it. الكُذُب has been read with three ḍammas, as a naʿt (adjective) of الألسنة, being the plural of كاذب, in which case you make أن لهم accusative by تصف.
His saying {لَا جرم أَن لَهُم النَّار}: أن is in the position of nominative by جرم, meaning "that has become due to them". It has also been said it is in the position of accusative, meaning "their deeds have earned them that the Fire is theirs". The original meaning of جرم is "to earn"; from it is المجرمون, i.e. those who earn sins.

mekki-muskil:64-64.t: His saying {وَهدى وَرَحْمَة}: two objects of purpose (mafʿūl li-ajlihi).

mekki-muskil:66-66.t:
His saying {مِمَّا فِي بطونه}: the hāʾ refers to الأنعام ("cattle"), because it is masculine and feminine: one says هو الأنعام and هي الأنعام; so this word runs on the dialect of those who make it masculine, and the one in Sūrat al-Muʾminūn on the dialect of those who make it feminine. This is related from Yūnus ibn Ḥabīb al-Baṣrī.
A second answer: the hāʾ in بطونه refers to "some", because من in His saying مِمَّا فِي بطونه indicates partition, namely those of them that have milk; so its implied form is "from what is in the bellies of some, which have milk", for not all of them have milk. This is the view of Abū ʿUbayda.
A third answer: the hāʾ in بطونه refers to "what is mentioned", its implied form being "We give you to drink from what is in the bellies of what is mentioned".
A fourth answer: the hāʾ refers to النَّعَم, because الأنعام and النعم are the same in meaning.
A fifth answer: the hāʾ refers to the singular of الأنعام, whose singular is نَعَم; نعم is masculine, and نعم is the singular of الأنعام. The Arabs turn the pronoun to the singular even if the plural wording has preceded; the poet — al-Aʿshā — said:
... فَإِن تعهديني ولي لمة ... فَإِن الْحَوَادِث أودى بهَا ...
(If you knew me when I had flowing locks — well, events have done away with them.)
He said بها and returned the pronoun in أودى to الحدثان or to الحادث, and made it masculine because it has no masculine from its own wording.
A sixth answer: the hāʾ refers specifically to the males; this view is related from Ismāʿīl al-Qāḍī. That indicated that the milk belongs to the stud: the milk is drunk from the females, yet the milk belongs to the stud, so the pronoun returns to it; and from this he argued that the milk in suckling [kinship] belongs to the stud (laban al-faḥl).
The hāʾ in His saying {تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ} refers to the singular of الثمرات mentioned before, so it refers to الثمر, just as the hāʾ in بطونه referred to the singular of الأنعام, which is النعم. It has also been said it refers rather to an implied مَا, because the implied form is "and of the fruits of the date-palms and the grapes is that from which you take…", so the hāʾ is for مَا, and من indicated it; dropping مَا is permissible just as dropping من is permissible in His saying, the Exalted, وَمَا منا إِلَّا لَهُ مقَام مَعْلُوم, i.e. "except one who has a known station": من was dropped because من in His saying وما منا indicates it. It has also been said that the hāʾ in منه refers to "what is mentioned", as though He said: "you take intoxicant from what is mentioned".
The hāʾ in His saying {فِيهِ شِفَاء للنَّاس} refers to the drink, which is honey; it has also been said, rather, it refers to the Quran.

mekki-muskil:8-8.t: His saying {وزينة}: accusative on the implication of a verb, i.e. "and We made [them] an adornment". It has also been said it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "and for adornment".

mekki-muskil:106-106.t:
His saying {من كفر بِاللَّه}: من is in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) from الكاذبين.
His saying {إِلَّا من أكره}: من is accusative as an exception.
The hāʾ in His saying {إِنَّه لَيْسَ لَهُ سُلْطَان} refers to Satan, may Allah curse him; it has also been said it is for the matter and the account [i.e. a pronoun of the matter].
The hāʾ in His saying {هم بِهِ مشركون} refers to Allah, exalted be His mention; it has also been said, to Satan, in the sense of "they, because of him, associate partners with Allah".
His saying {وَلَكِن من شرح بالْكفْر صَدرا}: من is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and فعليهم is the khabar (predicate).

mekki-muskil:116-116.t: His saying {لما تصف أَلْسِنَتكُم الْكَذِب}: الكذب is accusative by تصف, and مَا with تصف is a maṣdar (verbal noun). Whoever puts الكذب in the nominative with ḍamma on the kāf and the dhāl (الكُذُبُ) makes it a naʿt (adjective) of الألسنة. Al-Ḥasan, Ṭalḥa and Maʿmar read الكَذِبِ in the genitive with fatḥa on the kāf, making it a naʿt of مَا or a badal (substitute) from it.

mekki-muskil:123-123.t: His saying {أَن اتبع مِلَّة إِبْرَاهِيم حَنِيفا}: حنيفا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the nominative implied pronoun in اتبع; it is not good for it to be a ḥāl from إبراهيم, because it is a muḍāf ilayhi. The meaning of حنيفا is "inclining away from all religions to the religion of Ibrāhīm"; the root meaning of al-ḥanaf is inclining, and from it comes الأحنف (one with a clubfoot).

mekki-muskil:127-127.t:
His saying {وَلَا تحزن عَلَيْهِم}: the hāʾ and mīm refer to the disbelievers, i.e. do not grieve over their holding back from faith; His saying يمكرون indicates that. It has also been said the pronoun is for the martyrs concerning whom وَإِن عَاقَبْتُمْ to the end of the sūra was revealed, i.e. do not grieve over the disbelievers' killing of them. الضَّيق with fatḥa is the maṣdar (verbal noun), and with kasra (الضِّيق) the noun. The Kufans related that الضَّيق with fatḥa is in the heart and the breast, and with kasra is in a garment, a house and the like.
بِسم الله الرَّحْمَن [Translator's note: the opening words of the basmala for the next sūra, as they stand at the end of this entry in the source.]

mekki-muskil:73-73.t: His saying {مَا لَا يملك لَهُم رزقا من السَّمَاوَات وَالْأَرْض شَيْئا}: شيئا is accusative as a badal (substitute) from رزق. According to the Kufans it is accusative by رزق [as its object]; according to the Basrans رزق is a noun, not a maṣdar (verbal noun), so it does not govern except in poetry.

mekki-muskil:91-91.t: His saying {بعد توكيدها}: this wāw in التوكيد is the original, and it may be replaced by a hamza, so you say تأكيد. It is not good to say that the wāw is a substitute for the hamza, just as that is not good in أحد, whose origin is وحد, so the hamza is a substitute for the wāw.

mekki-muskil:92-92.t:
His saying {أنكاثا}: accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun); its governor is نقضت, because it means نكثت نكثا ("she undid an undoing"), and أنكاث is the plural of نِكْث. Al-Zajjāj said: أنكاثا is accusative because it is in the meaning of the maṣdar.
His saying {دخلا}: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
His saying {أَن تكون أمة}: أن is in the position of accusative on the dropping of the preposition, its implied form being "by being (بِأَن تكون)" or "because of being (لِأَن تكون)".
His saying {هِيَ أربى من أمة}: هي is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and أربى is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of هي, and the clause is the khabar of كان. The Kufans permitted هي to be a separating pronoun (faṣl) with no grammatical position, with أربى in the position of accusative as the khabar of كان. This is the analogy of the Basrans' view, because they permitted هي, هو, أنا, أنت and the like to be separators with no grammatical position with kāna and its sisters, inna and its sisters, and ẓanna and its sisters, when after them comes a definite noun or what is close to definite; and أربى من أمة is among what is close to definite, because of the adherence of من to afʿal (the elative) and the length of the noun, since من and what follows it are part of the completion of afʿal. The Basrans made a distinction in this verse and did not permit هي to be a separator only because the noun of كان is indefinite; had it been definite, it would be good and permissible.
The hāʾ in {يبلوكم الله بِهِ} refers to the covenant; it has also been said it refers to the abundance and the rivalry in abundance.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿ويجعلون لما لا يعلمون نصيبا مما رزقناهم﴾: conjoined to what came before; ويجعلون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجعلون﴾; the clause ﴿لا يعلمون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; the pronoun in يعلمون refers back to the polytheists, and it has been said: it refers back to the idols indicated by ﴿ما﴾; نصيبًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يجعلون; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نصيبًا﴾; and the clause رزقناهم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿تالله لتسألن عما كنتم تفترون﴾: the tāʾ is the genitive-governing tāʾ of the oath, and the Divine Name is genitive (majrūr) by the tāʾ of the oath; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted, its implied form being "my oath (qasamī)"; the lām occurs in the answer of the oath; تسألن is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the presence of the nūn, which has been elided because of the succession of identical letters; the wāw, elided because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil; the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis; ﴿عما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تسألن﴾; the clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; and the clause تفترون is the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿ويجعلون لله البنات﴾: ﴿ويجعلون﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿لله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجعلون﴾. البنات: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يجعلون.
﴿سبحانه﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); together with its omitted verb it forms a parenthetical clause, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولهم ما يشتهون﴾: ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿ما﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يشتهون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. It has been said: ﴿ما﴾ is in the position of the accusative by an implied (muqaddar) verb. The clause ﴿ولهم ما يشتهون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the wāw is circumstantial, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of يجعلون.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿وإذا بشر أحدهم بالأنثى ظل وجهه مسودا وهو كظيم﴾: إذا is a future adverb of time containing the sense of condition; the clause ﴿بشر أحدهم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿بالأنثى﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بشر﴾; the clause ﴿ظل﴾ has no grammatical position; وجهه is the noun (ism) of ẓalla, and ﴿مسودًّا﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the wāw is also circumstantial; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and كظيم a khabar, and the clause is an overlapping ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿يتوارى من القوم من سوء ما بشر به﴾: the clause ﴿يتوارى﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿كظيم﴾; ﴿من القوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) it, and ﴿من سوء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to it; the first [min] is for the beginning [of the action], and the second for cause; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause بشر به is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿أيمسكه على هون أم يدسه في التراب﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the interrogative clause ﴿يمسكه﴾ is governed by something omitted which is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of يتوارى, i.e. "he hides, perplexed"; يمسكه is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على هون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the latent fāʿil or from the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿أم﴾ is a conjunction; ﴿يدسه﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يمسكه﴾; and ﴿في التراب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يدسه﴾.
﴿ألا﴾: a particle of alerting.
﴿ساء ما يحكمون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ساء﴾ is an inflexible past verb for expressing blame, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil is a pronoun necessarily latent, its implied form being ﴿هو﴾. ﴿ما﴾: an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, in the position of the accusative as a tamyīz (specification) of the fāʿil of ﴿ساء﴾; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "their judgement". The clause ﴿يحكمون﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾, the implied meaning being: "evil is it as a judgement that they judge".
Or ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun meaning alladhī, in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of ﴿ساء﴾, and the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e. "their judgement". The clause ﴿يحكمون﴾ is the ṣila of the relative, with no grammatical position.
Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). The clause ﴿يحكمون﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿ما﴾ and what it governs is in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of ﴿ساء﴾, the implied meaning being: "evil is their judging". The one specified for blame is omitted.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿للذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة مثل السوء﴾: ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the clause لا يؤمنون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿بالآخرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤمنون﴾; and مثل السوء is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ولله المثل الأعلى وهو العزيز الحكيم﴾: conjoined to what came before; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, العزيز a first khabar, and الحكيم a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿ولو يؤاخذ الله الناس بظلمهم ما ترك عليها من دابة﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لو is conditional; يؤاخذ الله الناس is an imperfect verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بظلمهم﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition of causation, i.e. "because of their wrongdoing", and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤاخذ﴾; the clause ﴿ما ترك﴾ has no grammatical position; ﴿ترك﴾ is a verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil; ﴿عليها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was [originally] an adjective of دابة; من is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and دابة is genitive (majrūr) in form and a mafʿūl bihi in position.
﴿ولكن يؤخرهم إلى أجل مسمى﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), inoperative because it is lightened; يؤخرهم is an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿إلى أجل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤخرهم﴾; and ﴿مسمى﴾ is a naʿt (adjective), i.e. "appointed".
﴿فإذا جاء أجلهم لا يستأخرون ساعة ولا يستقدمون﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive and the clause after it conjoined, or the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause after it resumptive, with no grammatical position; إذا is a future adverb of time containing the sense of condition; the clause ﴿جاء أجلهم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿لا يستأخرون﴾ has no grammatical position; ﴿ساعة﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿يستأخرون﴾; ﴿ولا يستقدمون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لا يستأخرون﴾.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿ويجعلون لله ما يكرهون وتصف ألسنتهم الكذب﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يجعلون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجعلون﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يجعلون﴾; the clause يكرهون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿تصف ألسنتهم الكذب﴾ is an imperfect verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿ويجعلون لله ما يكرهون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أن لهم الحسنى﴾: أن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh); الحسنى is its postponed noun (ism); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of anna; and anna with what falls within its scope is a badal (substitute) of the whole for the whole from الكذب.
﴿لا جرم أن لهم النار وأنهم مفرطون﴾: لا is negating; جرم is a past verb; أن is an abrogating particle; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar; النار is its postponed noun; and ﴿أنهم مفرطون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أن لهم النار﴾.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿تالله لقد أرسلنا إلى أمم من قبلك﴾: the tāʾ is the genitive-governing tāʾ of the oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) verb of oath; the lām occurs in the answer of the oath; قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); ﴿أرسلنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى أمم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾; and ﴿من قبلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective).
﴿فزين لهم الشيطان أعمالهم﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; زين is a past verb; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿زين﴾; الشيطان is the fāʿil, and أعمالهم the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فهو وليهم اليوم ولهم عذاب أليم﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿وليهم﴾ a khabar (predicate); ﴿اليوم﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to وليهم; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and أليم a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿وما أنزلنا عليك الكتاب إلا لتبين لهم الذي اختلفوا فيه﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ما is negating; أنزلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿عليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلنا﴾; الكتاب is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿لتبين﴾: the lām is for giving the reason, and ﴿تبين﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أنزلنا﴾.
﴿وهدى ورحمة لقوم يؤمنون﴾: هدى and رحمة are conjoined to the position of ﴿لتبين﴾, and they are made accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective), or attached to the maṣdar; and the clause ﴿يؤمنون﴾ is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿والله أنزل من السماء ماء فأحيا به الأرض بعد موتها﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause أنزل a khabar (predicate); ﴿من السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزل﴾; ﴿ماء﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فأحيا is conjoined to أنزل; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أحيا﴾; الأرض is a mafʿūl bihi; and in ﴿بعد موتها﴾ the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إن في ذلك لآية لقوم يسمعون﴾: inna and its fronted khabar; the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آية is the noun (ism) of inna; ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿آية﴾; and the clause يسمعون is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿وإن لكم في الأنعام لعبرة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿في الأنعام﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and عبرة is the postponed noun (ism) of inna.
﴿نسقيكم مما في بطونه من بين فرث ودم لبنا خالصا سائغا للشاربين﴾: نسقيكم: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نسقيكم﴾. ﴿في بطونه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿نسقيكم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿من بين فرث ودم﴾ is a ḥāl, because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of His words لبنًا and was placed before it; or it is a ḥāl from the ﴿ما﴾ preceding it; ﴿لبنًا﴾ is the second object of ﴿نسقيكم﴾; سائغًا is a naʿt; and ﴿للشاربين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سائغًا﴾. [Translator's note: the source does not parse خالصًا.]

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿ومن ثمرات النخيل والأعناب تتخذون منه سكرا ورزقا حسنا﴾: ﴿ومن ثمرات النخيل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿تتخذون﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun which is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "fruit from which they used to take intoxicant and good provision". It has been said: ﴿من ثمرات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to something omitted indicated by ﴿نسقيكم﴾, i.e. "We give you to drink of the juice of date-palms and grapes", and the clause ﴿تتخذون﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial). It has [also] been said: they are attached to ﴿تتخذون﴾, and ﴿من﴾ was repeated for emphasis. It has been said: it is attached to ﴿نسقيكم﴾, so that it is conjoined to ﴿مما في بطونه﴾. And it has been said: it is conjoined to الأنعام, i.e. "and in the fruits of the date-palms and grapes there is a lesson", then He explained the lesson by His words: تتخذون. The pronoun in ﴿منه﴾ refers back to the implied juice; سكرًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تتخذون; رزقًا is conjoined to ﴿سكرًا﴾; and حسنًا is a naʿt.
﴿إن في ذلك لآية لقوم يعقلون﴾: inna and its fronted khabar; the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آية is its postponed noun (ism); and the clause يعقلون is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿وأوحى ربك إلى النحل أن اتخذي من الجبال بيوتا ومن الشجر ومما يعرشون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive to what precedes it, or resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿أوحى ربك﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى النحل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحى﴾. ﴿أن﴾: explicative, because revelation (waḥy) contains the meaning of saying without its letters, and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, and together with what it governs it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿أوحى﴾; the clause ﴿اتخذي﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. ﴿من الجبال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اتخذي﴾, and min is partitive; ﴿بيوتًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿اتخذي﴾; ﴿من الشجر﴾ is conjoined to ﴿من الجبال﴾, and likewise ﴿مما يعرشون﴾.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿ثم كلي من كل الثمرات فاسلكي سبل ربك ذللا﴾: ثم is a conjunction for delay; ﴿كلي﴾ is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿من كل الثمرات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كلي﴾; ﴿فاسلكي﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and اسلكي is conjoined to ﴿كلي﴾; ﴿سبل ربك﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿ذللًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from السبل, or from the fāʿil of ﴿اسلكي﴾, i.e. "while you are submissive to what you have been commanded".
﴿يخرج من بطونها شراب مختلف ألوانه فيه شفاء للناس﴾: يخرج is an imperfect verb; ﴿من بطونها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخرج﴾; شراب is the fāʿil of يخرج; ﴿مختلف﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of شراب; ﴿ألوانه﴾ is the fāʿil of ﴿مختلف﴾, because it is an active participle which operates as a verb does; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); شفاء is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿للناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شفاء﴾; and the clause is a second naʿt of شراب.
﴿إن في ذلك لآية لقوم يتفكرون﴾: inna and its fronted khabar; the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آية is its postponed noun (ism); and the clause يتفكرون is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿والله خلقكم ثم يتوفاكم ومنكم من يرد إلى أرذل العمر﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause ﴿خلقكم﴾ a khabar (predicate); ﴿ثم﴾ is a conjunction for delay; ﴿ومنكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar, and it is conjoined to something implied, i.e. "so among you is one who remains retaining the strength of his body and mind, and among you…"; ﴿مَن﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause يرد is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa"; and ﴿إلى أرذل العمر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرد﴾.
﴿لكي لا يعلم بعد علم شيئا إن الله عليم قدير﴾: the lām is the lām of giving the reason; ﴿كي﴾ is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; لا is negating; يعلم is accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿كي﴾; the lām with what it governs is attached to ﴿يرد﴾; or the lām is for outcome (ṣayrūra), i.e. "so that his end was that he returned to the state of childhood in forgetfulness and lack of perception"; ﴿بعد علم﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿يعلم﴾; شيئًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يعلم, and it has been said: ﴿شيئًا﴾ is accusative by العلم; إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh), the Divine Name its noun (ism), عليم its first khabar, and قدير its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿والله فضل بعضكم على بعض في الرزق﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause ﴿فضل﴾ a khabar (predicate); بعضكم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على بعض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فضل﴾; and ﴿في الرزق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "in the state of your being provided for, so among you is the rich and among you the poor".
﴿فما الذين فضلوا برادي رزقهم على ما ملكت أيمانهم﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā which operates as laysa does; ﴿الذين﴾ is the noun (ism) of mā; the clause ﴿فضلوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿برادي﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿رادي﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive by the bāʾ in form; ﴿رزقهم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), being an annexation of the maṣdar (verbal noun) to its object; ﴿على ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رادي﴾; and ملكت أيمانهم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿فهم فيه سواء﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سواء﴾; and ﴿سواء﴾ is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾.
﴿أفبنعمة الله يجحدون﴾: an interrogation of disapproval and rebuke; the fāʾ is conjunctive to something implied (muqaddar), i.e. "they associate partners with Him and so deny His favour"; and ﴿بنعمة الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجحدون﴾, because it contains the meaning of ingratitude (kufrān).

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿والله جعل لكم من أنفسكم أزواجا﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause ﴿جعل﴾ a khabar (predicate); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جعل﴾; ﴿من أنفسكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and أزواجًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of جعل.
﴿وجعل لكم من أزواجكم بنين وحفدة﴾: conjoined to what preceded; ﴿من أزواجكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; بنين is the mafʿūl bihi of جعل, and حفدة is conjoined to بنين.
﴿ورزقكم من الطيبات أفبالباطل يؤمنون وبنعمت الله هم يكفرون﴾: ﴿ورزقكم﴾ is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من الطيبات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رزقكم﴾; the hamza is for interrogation of disapproval and rebuke; the fāʾ is conjunctive to something implied, i.e. "they disbelieve in Allah and so believe in falsehood"; ﴿بنعمة الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يكفرون﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause يكفرون a khabar. [Translator's note: the source does not separately parse بالباطل يؤمنون.]

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿ويعبدون من دون الله ما لا يملك لهم رزقا من السماوات والأرض﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; يعبدون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿من دون الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿ما﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿لا يملك﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; رزقًا is a mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿من السماوات والأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رزقًا﴾, or attached to ﴿رزقًا﴾.
﴿شيئا ولا يستطيعون﴾: شيئًا is a mafʿūl bihi of ﴿رزقًا﴾, or a badal (substitute) from it in the sense of "a little"; the clause ﴿ولا يستطيعون﴾ is conjoined to the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, or is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the wāw refers back to ﴿ما﴾, and what is meant by it is their gods.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿فلا تضربوا لله الأمثال﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive; ﴿تضربوا﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تضربوا﴾; and الأمثال is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إن الله يعلم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh), the Divine Name its noun (ism), and the clause يعلم a khabar (predicate); the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya).
﴿وأنتم لا تعلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; أنتم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause لا تعلمون a khabar.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿ضرب الله مثلا عبدا مملوكا لا يقدر على شيء﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; ﴿ضرب الله مثلًا﴾ is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عبدًا﴾ is a badal (substitute) from ﴿مثلًا﴾; مملوكًا is a naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿لا يقدر على شيء﴾ is a second naʿt; and ﴿على شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يقدر﴾, i.e. of the dispositions [of affairs].
﴿ومن رزقناه منا رزقا حسنا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and من is conjoined to ﴿عبدًا مملوكًا﴾; ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun, or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, as though it were said: "and a free man whom We provided", to correspond with عبدًا; the clause ﴿رزقناه﴾ is a ṣila (relative clause) on the first [view], with no grammatical position, and a naʿt on the second; نا is the fāʿil and the hāʾ a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿منا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رزقناه﴾; رزقًا is a second mafʿūl bihi, or an accusative mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); and حسنًا is a naʿt of ﴿رزقًا﴾.
﴿فهو ينفق منه سرا وجهرا هل يستوون﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause ينفق a khabar (predicate); ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينفق﴾; ﴿سرا﴾ is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "a secret spending", or is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "keeping it secret". ﴿جهرا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿سرا﴾, accusative. ﴿هل﴾ is an interrogative particle for negation. ﴿يستوون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the presence of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil.
﴿الحمد لله بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: الحمد is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); أكثرهم is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿لا يعلمون﴾ a khabar.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿وضرب الله مثلا رجلين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿ضرب الله مثلًا﴾ is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and رجلين is a badal (substitute) from ﴿مثلًا﴾.
﴿أحدهما أبكم لا يقدر على شيء﴾: ﴿أحدهما﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿أبكم﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿لا يقدر على شيء﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أبكم﴾.
﴿وهو كلٌّ على مولاه﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and ﴿كلٌّ﴾ its khabar; ﴿على مولاه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كلٌّ﴾.
﴿أينما يوجهه لا يأت بخير﴾: أينما is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place, attached to the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and it has been said: to its apodosis; لا is negating; ﴿يأت﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and ﴿بخير﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأت﴾.
﴿هل يستوي هو ومن يأمر بالعدل وهو على صراط مستقيم﴾: ﴿هل﴾ is an interrogative particle whose meaning is negation; يستوي is an imperfect verb; ﴿هو﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) fāʿil; ﴿مَن﴾ is conjoined to the latent fāʿil in ﴿يستوي﴾; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and ﴿على صراط مستقيم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar; and the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source does not parse يأمر بالعدل, which is the actual ṣila of مَن; the nominal clause وهو على صراط مستقيم would more usually be read as a ḥāl.]

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿ولله غيب السماوات والأرض وما أمر الساعة إلا كلمح البصر أو هو أقرب﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); غيب السماوات والأرض is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿ولله غيب السماوات والأرض﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; أمر is a mubtadaʾ and الساعة muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿كلمح البصر﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as khabar; ﴿لمح﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and ﴿البصر﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and أقرب its khabar.
﴿إن الله على كل شيء قدير﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh) and the Divine Name its noun (ism); ﴿على كل شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قدير﴾; and قدير is the khabar of inna.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿والله أخرجكم من بطون أمهاتكم﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause أخرجكم a khabar (predicate); ﴿من بطون أمهاتكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخرجكم﴾.
﴿لا تعلمون شيئا﴾: the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf, i.e. "not knowing anything"; ﴿شيئًا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وجعل لكم السمع والأبصار والأفئدة لعلكم تشكرون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; جعل is conjoined to أخرجكم, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa"; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second object of جعل; السمع is its first object, and الأبصار and الأفئدة are conjoined to it; لعل is an abrogating particle (nāsikh), the kāf its noun (ism), and the clause تشكرون its khabar.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿ألم يروا إلى الطير مسخرات في جو السماء﴾: the hamza is for interrogation of affirmation (taqrīr); لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يروا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى الطير﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يروا﴾; مسخرات is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿في جو السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مسخرات﴾.
﴿ما يمسكهن إلا الله﴾: the clause is circumstantial; ما is negating; يمسكهن is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil. [Translator's note: the source states both a latent fāʿil and الله as fāʿil; as written.]
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يؤمنون﴾: inna and its fronted khabar (predicate); the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آيات is its postponed noun (ism); ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿آيات﴾; and the clause يؤمنون is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿والله جعل لكم من بيوتكم سكنا﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause ﴿جعل﴾ a khabar (predicate); its first object is ﴿سكنًا﴾; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted first object [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably "second object" is meant, since سكنًا has just been called the first]; ﴿من بيوتكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سكنًا﴾ and came before it. If ﴿جعل﴾ means "created", one of the two prepositional phrases is attached to it, and it is content with a single object.
﴿وجعل لكم من جلود الأنعام بيوتا تستخفونها يوم ظعنكم ويوم إقامتكم﴾: ﴿وجعل لكم من جلود الأنعام بيوتًا﴾ is conjoined to what preceded; the clause تستخفونها is a naʿt of ﴿بيوتًا﴾; in ﴿يوم ظعنكم﴾ the adverb is attached to ﴿تستخفونها﴾; and ﴿يوم إقامتكم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يوم ظعنكم﴾.
﴿ومن أصوافها وأوبارها وأشعارها أثاثا ومتاعا إلى حين﴾: ﴿ومن أصوافها﴾ is conjoined to ﴿من جلود الأنعام﴾; ﴿أثاثًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بيوتًا﴾, i.e. "and He made for you from their wool furnishings"; ﴿متاعًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أثاثًا﴾; and ﴿إلى حين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿متاعًا﴾, or a naʿt of it.

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿والله جعل لكم مما خلق ظلالا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause ﴿جعل﴾ a khabar (predicate); ﴿ظلالًا﴾ is its first object; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object, a ḥāl (circumstantial) [Translator's note: so in the source, «مفعول ثان حال»]; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from ﴿ظلالا﴾. If ﴿جعل﴾ means "created", one of the two prepositional phrases is attached to it, and it is content with a single object. The clause ﴿خلق﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position.
﴿وجعل لكم من الجبال أكنانا﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿وجعل لكم سرابيل تقيكم الحر﴾: the clause ﴿تقيكم الحر﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سرابيل﴾; the conjoined item has been omitted because it is known, i.e. "and the cold".
﴿وسرابيل تقيكم بأسكم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; سرابيل is conjoined to the first سرابيل; the clause ﴿تقيكم﴾ is a naʿt; تقيكم is an imperfect verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); the kāf is its first object, and بأسكم its second object.
﴿كذلك يتم نعمته عليكم لعلكم تسلمون﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun); ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿يتم نعمته﴾ is a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لعل is an abrogating particle (nāsikh), the kāf its noun (ism), and the clause تسلمون its khabar.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t: ﴿فإن تولوا فإنما عليك البلاغ المبين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; تولوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of in is omitted, i.e. "then there is no blame upon you"; the fāʾ gives the reason; ﴿إنما﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), inna restrained by the restraining mā (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿عليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿البلاغ﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and المبين a naʿt (adjective); and the clause ﴿فإن تولوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t: ﴿يعرفون نعمت الله ثم ينكرونها وأكثرهم الكافرون﴾: يعرفون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); نعمة الله is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿ثم﴾ is a conjunction for delay; ﴿ينكرونها﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يعرفون﴾; ﴿وأكثرهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; أكثرهم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and الكافرون its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:84-84.t:
﴿ويوم نبعث من كل أمة شهيدا﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember (udhkur)"; the clause ﴿نبعث﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); من كل أمة is a ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿شهيدًا﴾; and شهيدًا is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ثم لا يؤذن للذين كفروا ولا هم يستعتبون﴾: ثم is a conjunction for delay; لا is negating; يؤذن is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for what has not had its agent named); للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; ولا: the wāw is conjunctive and لا negating; هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يستعتبون a khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:85-85.t:
