﴿وإذا رأى الذين ظلموا العذاب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; إذا is a future adverb of time containing the sense of condition; the clause رأى is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الذين is the fāʿil (agent) of رأى; the clause ظلموا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and العذاب is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فلا يخفف عنهم ولا هم ينظرون﴾: the fāʾ links the answer of idhā; لا is negating; يخفف is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for what has not had its agent named), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), i.e. the punishment; لا is conjunctive [Translator's note: so in the source]; هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ينظرون a khabar (predicate). [Translator's note: the source does not parse عنهم.]

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿وإذا رأى الذين أشركوا شركاءهم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; إذا is a future adverb of time containing the sense of condition; the clause رأى is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الذين is the fāʿil (agent) of رأى; the clause أشركوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and شركاءهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of رأى.
﴿قالوا ربنا هؤلاء شركاؤنا الذين كنا ندعو من دونك﴾: the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of ﴿إذا﴾; ﴿ربنا﴾ is a vocative in construct (munādā muḍāf), the vocative particle having been omitted from it; ﴿هؤلاء﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and شركاؤنا a khabar (predicate); ﴿الذين﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿شركاؤنا﴾; ﴿كنا﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, ﴿نا﴾ its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿ندعو﴾ the khabar of ﴿كنا﴾; the clause ﴿كنا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; and ﴿من دونك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted object of ندعو, i.e. "we call upon them and worship them besides You".
﴿فألقوا إليهم القول إنكم لكاذبون﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ألقوا is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿إليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ألقوا﴾; ﴿القول﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿إنكم لكاذبون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh), the kāf its noun, the lām the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and كاذبون its khabar; and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿وألقوا إلى الله يومئذ السلم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ألقوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and they are the disbelievers; ﴿إلى الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ألقوا﴾; ﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم is an adverb of time attached to ﴿ألقوا﴾, and إذٍ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied sukūn, because the place [of the sukūn] is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the tanwīn compensating for an omitted clause; and السلم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ضل is a past verb; ﴿عنهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it; ﴿ما﴾ is the fāʿil of ضل; كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the wāw its noun (ism), and the clause يفترون the khabar (predicate) of ﴿كانوا﴾; and the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:88-88.t: ﴿الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله زدناهم عذابا فوق العذاب بما كانوا يفسدون﴾: الذين is a mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) being the clause ﴿زدناهم﴾; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿صدوا عن سبيل الله﴾ is conjoined to ﴿كفروا﴾; ﴿زدناهم﴾ is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عذابًا﴾ is a second object; ﴿فوق العذاب﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عذابًا﴾; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿زدناهم﴾; the bāʾ is causal and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), i.e. "because of their obstructing and their corrupting"; كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the wāw its noun (ism), and the clause يفسدون its khabar.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t:
﴿ويوم نبعث في كل أمة شهيدا عليهم من أنفسهم﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember (udhkur)"; the clause ﴿نبعث﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿في كل أمة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نبعث﴾; شهيدًا is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شهيدًا﴾; and ﴿من أنفسهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿شهيدًا﴾.
﴿وجئنا بك شهيدا على هؤلاء﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; جئنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿بك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جئنا﴾; ﴿شهيدًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿على هؤلاء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شهيدًا﴾.
﴿ونزلنا عليك الكتاب تبيانا لكل شيء وهدى ورحمة وبشرى للمسلمين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; نزلنا is conjoined to ﴿جئنا﴾, and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿عليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نزلنا﴾; ﴿الكتاب﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿تبيانًا﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or a ḥāl, i.e. "making clear"; ﴿لكل شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تبيانًا﴾; هدى, رحمة and بشرى are conjoined to ﴿تبيانًا﴾; and ﴿للمسلمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بشرى﴾.

muyesser-irab:90-90.t:
﴿إن الله يأمر بالعدل والإحسان وإيتاء ذي القربى﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh), the Divine Name its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿يأمر﴾ the khabar (predicate) of inna; ﴿بالعدل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأمر﴾; الإحسان is conjoined to العدل, and likewise ﴿إيتاء﴾; and ﴿ذي القربى﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وينهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر والبغي يعظكم لعلكم تذكرون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ينهى is conjoined to يأمر, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿عن الفحشاء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينهى﴾, and what follows it is conjoined to it; the clause ﴿يعظكم﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of يأمر and ينهى; لعل is an abrogating particle, the kāf its noun, and the clause ﴿تذكرون﴾ its khabar.

muyesser-irab:91-91.t:
﴿وأوفوا بعهد الله إذا عاهدتم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أوفوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿بعهد الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوفوا﴾; إذا is a future adverb of time containing the sense of condition; and the clause عاهدتم is that to which the adverb is annexed (muḍāf ilayhi).
﴿ولا تنقضوا الأيمان بعد توكيدها وقد جعلتم الله عليكم كفيلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لا is prohibitive; تنقضوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā, and the wāw is the fāʿil; الأيمان is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بعد﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿تنقضوا﴾, and ﴿توكيدها﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the wāw is circumstantial, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of تنقضوا; قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); ﴿جعلتم الله﴾ is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كفيلًا﴾; and كفيلًا is the second object of جعلتم.
﴿إن الله يعلم ما تفعلون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh), the Divine Name its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿يعلم...﴾ the khabar (predicate) of inna; ﴿ما﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi, and تفعلون is its ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿ولا تكونوا كالتي نقضت غزلها من بعد قوة أنكاثا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لا is prohibitive; تكونوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; تكونوا is an imperfect verb], jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, and the wāw is its noun (ism); ﴿كالتي﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of تكونوا, and ﴿التي﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿نقضت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position; غزلها is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من بعد قوة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of نقضت, i.e. "having made it firm", or from its object, i.e. "made firm"; ﴿أنكاثًا﴾ is accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb, i.e. "and so she made it into broken strands", or by ﴿نقضت﴾ containing the meaning of "made into (ṣayyarat)", so that it is a second object; it has been said: it is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), because the meaning of نقضت is "unravelled (nakathat)"; and it has been said: it is a ḥāl from ﴿غزلها﴾, i.e. "undone".
﴿تتخذون أيمانكم دخلا بينكم أن تكون أمة هي أربى من أمة﴾: the clause ﴿تتخذون﴾ is a ḥāl from the pronoun of تكونوا, i.e. "do not be like her, taking your oaths as deception"; ﴿تتخذون﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; أيمانكم is a first object, and ﴿دخلًا﴾ a second object; ﴿بينكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿دخلًا﴾; the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "for fear that there be"; تكون is an incomplete, abrogating past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; تكون is an imperfect verb]; ﴿أمة﴾ is the noun of تكون; ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿أربى﴾ a khabar, and the clause is the khabar of تكون; and ﴿من أمة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أربى﴾.
﴿إنما يبلوكم الله به﴾: إنما is inna restrained by the restraining mā (kāffa wa-makfūfa), and it is for restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿يبلوكم الله﴾ is a verb, a fronted object and a postponed fāʿil; and ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يبلوكم﴾.
﴿وليبينن لكم يوم القيامة ما كنتم فيه تختلفون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām occurs in the answer of an implied (muqaddar) oath; ﴿يبينن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, necessarily; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يبينن﴾; ﴿يوم القيامة﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿ما﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿كنتم﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause كنتم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تختلفون﴾; and the clause ﴿تختلفون﴾ is the khabar of كنتم.

muyesser-irab:93-93.t:
﴿ولو شاء الله لجعلكم أمة واحدة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لو is conditional; ﴿شاء الله﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the lām occurs in the answer of law; ﴿جعلكم﴾ is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a first object; أمة is a second object, and واحدة a naʿt (adjective).
﴿ولكن يضل من يشاء﴾: the wāw is circumstantial [Translator's note: so in the source]; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), inoperative because it has been lightened; ﴿يضل﴾ is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "huwa"; ﴿من﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿يهدي من يشاء﴾ is conjoined to what preceded.
﴿ولتسألن عما كنتم تعملون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām occurs in the answer of an implied (muqaddar) oath; تسألن is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), because the nūn [of emphasis] is not directly attached to it, so it is declinable (muʿrab), and the sign of its nominative is the presence of the nūn, which has been elided because of the succession of identical letters; the wāw, elided because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis; ﴿عما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تسألن﴾; and the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿ولا تتخذوا أيمانكم دخلا بينكم﴾: لا is prohibitive; تتخذوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); أيمانكم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ﴿دخلًا﴾ a second object; and ﴿بينكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿دخلًا﴾.
﴿فتزل قدم بعد ثبوتها﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation preceded by a prohibition; ﴿تزل﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an; ﴿قدم﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿بعد﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿تزل﴾, and ثبوتها is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وتذوقوا السوء بما صددتم عن سبيل الله ولكم عذاب عظيم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; تذوقوا is conjoined to تزل; السوء is a mafʿūl bihi; the bāʾ is a preposition of causation, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and together with what it governs it is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿تذوقوا﴾; ﴿عن سبيل الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿صددتم﴾; ﴿لكم﴾ is a fronted khabar (predicate), عذاب a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and عظيم its naʿt.

muyesser-irab:95-95.t:
﴿ولا تشتروا بعهد الله ثمنا قليلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لا is prohibitive; تشتروا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā; ﴿بعهد الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تشتروا﴾, the bāʾ entering upon what is given up; ﴿ثمنًا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ﴿قليلًا﴾ a naʿt (adjective).
﴿إنما عند الله هو خير لكم إن كنتم تعلمون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh) and ﴿ما﴾ its noun (ism); the adverb is attached to something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and خير a khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of inna; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it; إن is conditional; كنتم is an incomplete, abrogating past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is the noun of kāna, and the clause تعلمون its khabar; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then do not break [them]".

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿ما عندكم ينفد وما عند الله باق﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿عندكم﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; the clause ينفد is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾; ﴿وما عند الله باق﴾ is conjoined to what came before and is like it in its i'rab.
﴿ولنجزين الذين صبروا أجرهم بأحسن ما كانوا يعملون﴾: the lām occurs in the answer of an implied (muqaddar) oath; نجزين is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is made emphatic by the doubled nūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "naḥnu"; ﴿الذين صبروا﴾ is its object, and أجرهم a second object of ﴿نجزين﴾; ﴿بأحسن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نجزين﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun); كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the wāw its noun (ism), and the clause يعملون its khabar. It has been said: ﴿ما﴾ is a relative, the implied meaning being: "with a recompense better than their deeds which they used to do in this world", or "We make the reward proportionate to the best of their deeds".

muyesser-irab:97-97.t:
﴿من عمل صالحا من ذكر أو أنثى﴾: من is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿عمل﴾ is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); صالحا: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿عمل﴾, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "does a righteous deed". ﴿من ذكر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿عمل﴾; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; and ﴿أنثى﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ذكر﴾.
﴿وهو مؤمن فلنحيينه حياة طيبة﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and ﴿مؤمن﴾ a khabar (predicate), and the clause is circumstantial; ﴿فلنحيينه﴾: the fāʾ is linking, the lām occurs in the answer of an implied (muqaddar) oath, ﴿نحيينه﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿حياة﴾ is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, because it is a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar). ﴿طيبة﴾ is a naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿فلنحيينه﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾. It has been said: ﴿من﴾ is a relative noun, and the fāʾ enters because of the scent of condition in the qualified noun [Translator's note: so in the source, «الموصوف»; presumably "the relative (al-mawṣūl)" is meant], and the clause ﴿فلنحيينه﴾ is its khabar.
﴿ولنجزينهم أجرهم بأحسن ما كانوا يعملون﴾: the lām occurs in the answer of the oath; نجزينهم is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is made emphatic by the doubled nūn, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "naḥnu"; ﴿هم﴾ is its object, and ﴿أجرهم﴾ a second object of ﴿نجزين﴾; ﴿بأحسن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نجزين﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the wāw its noun (ism), and the clause يعملون its khabar. It has been said: ما is a relative, the implied meaning being: "with a recompense better than their deeds which they used to do in this world", or "We make the reward proportionate to the best of their deeds".

muyesser-irab:98-98.t: ﴿فإذا قرأت القرآن فاستعذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إذا is an adverb for future time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استعذ﴾; the clause ﴿قرأت﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); القرآن is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "when you intend to recite the Qur'an"; the fāʾ links the answer; استعذ is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "anta"; ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استعذ﴾; ﴿من الشيطان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, likewise attached to ﴿استعذ﴾; and الرجيم is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:99-99.t: ﴿إنه ليس له سلطان على الذين آمنوا وعلى ربهم يتوكلون﴾: the clause gives the reason for the command; إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh), the hāʾ its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿ليس﴾ its khabar (predicate); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar of ﴿ليس﴾, and ﴿سلطان﴾ is its postponed noun; ﴿على الذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سلطان﴾; آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and ﴿على ربهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتوكلون﴾.

muyesser-irab:100-100.t: ﴿إنما سلطانه على الذين يتولونه والذين هم به مشركون﴾: ﴿إنما﴾ is inna restrained by the restraining mā (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿سلطانه﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿على الذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿يتولونه﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position; ﴿الذين﴾ is conjoined to the first ﴿الذين﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مشركون﴾; ﴿مشركون﴾ is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause ﴿هم به مشركون﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:101-101.t:
﴿وإذا بدلنا آية مكان آية﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; إذا is a future adverb of time; ﴿بدلنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿آية﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿مكان﴾ is a second object of ﴿بدلنا﴾, or an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بدلنا﴾; and ﴿آية﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿والله أعلم بما ينزل قالوا﴾: the wāw is parenthetical, and the clause is parenthetical between the condition of ﴿إذا﴾ and its answer, with no grammatical position; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿أعلم﴾ a khabar (predicate); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعلم﴾; ﴿ينزل﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of ﴿إذا﴾.
﴿إنما أنت مفتر بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); إنما is inna restrained by the restraining mā (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿أنت﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and ﴿مفتر﴾ a khabar; ﴿بل﴾ is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); ﴿أكثرهم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿لا يعلمون﴾ a khabar; the object of يعلمون has been omitted because it is known, i.e. "the reality of substitution and abrogation and their benefit".

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿قل نزله روح القدس من ربك بالحق ليثبت الذين آمنوا﴾: ﴿نزله﴾ is a verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), [forming] a clause, and ﴿نزله﴾ is the object of the saying of ﴿قل﴾; روح is a postponed fāʿil (agent) and القدس muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿من ربك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نزله﴾; ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "accompanied by the truth"; ﴿وليثبت﴾: the lām is the lām of giving the reason, and يثبت is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of reason; the preposition and genitive noun made up of the lām of reason and the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb are attached to an omitted mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa"; الذين is a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهدى وبشرى للمسلمين﴾: these two maṣdars (verbal nouns) are conjoined to the position of ﴿ليثبت﴾, i.e. "as a making firm, a guidance and glad tidings".

muyesser-irab:103-103.t:
﴿ولقد نعلم أنهم يقولون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām occurs in the answer of an implied (muqaddar) oath; قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); نعلم is an imperfect verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); anna with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of نعلم; أن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh), the hāʾ its noun (ism), and the clause يقولون its khabar (predicate).
﴿إنما يعلمه بشر﴾: the clause is the object of their saying (maqūl qawlihim); ﴿إنما﴾ is inna restrained by the restraining mā (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿يعلمه بشر﴾ is a verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and بشر is a postponed fāʿil.
﴿لسان الذي يلحدون إليه أعجمي وهذا لسان عربي مبين﴾: لسان is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الذي﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿يلحدون إليه﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿أعجمي﴾ is the khabar of ﴿لسان﴾, i.e. "not clear"; هذا is a mubtadaʾ and عربي a khabar, and مبين a naʿt (adjective). [Translator's note: the source passes over the second لسان; as written, عربي is called the khabar.]

muyesser-irab:104-104.t: ﴿إن الذين لا يؤمنون بآيات الله لا يهديهم الله ولهم عذاب أليم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh) and الذين its noun (ism); the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿بآيات الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمنون﴾; the clause ﴿لا يهديهم الله﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of inna; the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and أليم its naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿إنما يفتري الكذب الذين لا يؤمنون بآيات الله﴾: ﴿إنما﴾ is inna restrained by the restraining mā (kāffa wa-makfūfa); يفتري is an imperfect verb; الكذب is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الذين a postponed fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون بآيات الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿إنما يفتري...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأولئك هم الكاذبون﴾: the wāw is parenthetical or conjunctive; أولئك is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿هم﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and الكاذبون the khabar (predicate) of أولئك; or ﴿هم﴾ is a second mubtadaʾ and الكاذبون the khabar of ﴿هم﴾, the clause being the khabar of أولئك; the clause ﴿أولئك هم الكاذبون﴾ is parenthetical, or conjoined to the resumptive clause before it, and on both views it has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:106-106.t:
﴿من كفر بالله من بعد إيمانه إلا من أكره وقلبه مطمئن بالإيمان﴾: ﴿مَن﴾ is a badal (substitute) from ﴿الذين لا يؤمنون بآيات الله﴾, and the clause ﴿وأولئك هم الكاذبون﴾ is a parenthesis between the substitute and what it substitutes for. It has been said: ﴿مَن﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "upon them is wrath", because what follows the second ﴿من﴾ indicates it. And it has been said: ﴿مَن﴾ is conditional and its answer is implied (muqaddar), its implied form being ﴿فعليهم غضب﴾, because what follows the second ﴿مَن﴾ indicates it. The clause ﴿كفر بالله﴾: the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كفر﴾; ﴿من بعد إيمانه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); إلا is a particle of exception; ﴿مَن﴾ is a connected excepted [i.e. of the same kind], and it has been said: it is disconnected; the clause ﴿أكره﴾ is the ṣila of the relative, with no grammatical position; ﴿وقلبه﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; قلبه is a mubtadaʾ and مطمئن a khabar; and ﴿بالإيمان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مطمئن﴾.
﴿ولكن من شرح بالكفر صدرا فعليهم غضب من الله ولهم عذاب عظيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لكن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh), and its noun (ism) is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); ﴿مَن﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; شرح is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) if ﴿مَن﴾ is taken as conditional, and a ṣila with no grammatical position if ﴿مَن﴾ is taken as a relative; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no ﴿الله﴾ after شرح — its fāʿil is a latent pronoun referring to مَن; the line appears carried over from elsewhere]; ﴿صدرًا﴾ is a tamyīz (specification), i.e. "he was pleased with it in soul and believed it"; ﴿فعليهم﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; غضب is a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and عظيم a naʿt. [Translator's note: the source does not parse بالكفر.]

muyesser-irab:107-107.t:
﴿ذلك بأنهم استحبوا الحياة الدنيا على الآخرة﴾: the reference is to what preceded in the mention of wrath and punishment; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿بأنهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), i.e. "established because they…", so the bāʾ is causal; أن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh), the hāʾ its noun (ism), and the clause استحبوا its khabar, i.e. "they chose"; الحياة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and الدنيا a naʿt (adjective); and ﴿على الآخرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استحبوا﴾.
﴿وأن الله لا يهدي القوم الكافرين﴾: ﴿وأن الله﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بأنهم﴾; أن is an abrogating particle, the Divine Name its noun, and the clause لا يهدي its khabar; القوم is a mafʿūl bihi, and الكافرين a naʿt of القوم.

muyesser-irab:108-108.t:
﴿أولئك الذين طبع الله على قلوبهم وسمعهم وأبصارهم﴾: أولئك is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and الذين its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿طبع الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿على قلوبهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿طبع﴾; and ﴿سمعهم وأبصارهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿قلوبهم﴾.
﴿وأولئك هم الغافلون﴾: ﴿أولئك﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿هم﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and ﴿الغافلون﴾ the khabar of ﴿أولئك﴾; or ﴿هم﴾ is a second mubtadaʾ and ﴿الغافلون﴾ the khabar of ﴿هم﴾, and the clause ﴿هم الغافلون﴾ is the khabar of ﴿أولئك﴾.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t: ﴿لا جرم أنهم في الآخرة هم الخاسرون﴾: لا is negating; جرم is a past verb; أن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh) and the hāʾ its noun (ism); ﴿في الآخرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿الخاسرون﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and الخاسرون its khabar (predicate); and the clause is the khabar of inna [Translator's note: so in the source; the particle in the ayah is anna].

muyesser-irab:110-110.t:
﴿ثم إن ربك للذين هاجروا من بعد ما فتنوا﴾: ﴿ثم﴾ is for sequence with delay; إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh) and ربك its noun (ism); ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna, in the sense that He is their protector and helper; the clause ﴿هاجروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿من بعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿هاجروا﴾; and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "after their being tried".
﴿ثم جاهدوا وصبروا﴾: ثم is a conjunction with delay; جاهدوا and صبروا are conjoined to هاجروا.
﴿إن ربك من بعدها لغفور رحيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle and ربك its noun; ﴿من بعدها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); غفور is the first khabar of inna, and رحيم its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:111-111.t:
﴿يوم تأتي كل نفس تجادل عن نفسها﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember (udhkur)"; the clause ﴿تأتي﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿كل نفس﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of تأتي; the clause ﴿تجادل﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿عن نفسها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تجادل﴾.
﴿وتوفى كل نفس ما عملت وهم لا يظلمون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿توفى﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تجادل﴾; ﴿كل نفس﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿ما عملت﴾ is the second object of ﴿توفى﴾; ﴿وهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial or conjunctive; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿لا يظلمون﴾ a khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:112-112.t:
﴿وضرب الله مثلا قرية﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ضرب الله مثلًا is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and قرية is a badal (substitute) from ﴿مثلًا﴾, i.e. He made the town marked by these features an example for every people upon whom Allah bestowed favour, and the favour made them insolent, so they disbelieved.
﴿كانت آمنة مطمئنة يأتيها رزقها رغدا من كل مكان﴾: كانت is an incomplete, abrogating past verb; its noun (ism) is latent (mustatir); آمنة is its khabar (predicate) and مطمئنة a second khabar; the clause ﴿كانت﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of قرية; يأتيها is an imperfect verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and رزقها a postponed fāʿil; the clause ﴿يأتيها﴾ is a third khabar; ﴿رغدًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from رزقها, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a plentiful coming". ﴿من كل مكان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأتيها﴾.
﴿فكفرت بأنعم الله فأذاقها الله لباس الجوع والخوف بما كانوا يصنعون﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; كفرت is a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent, referring back to the town; ﴿بأنعم الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كفرت﴾; ﴿فأذاقها﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive for immediate succession, and ﴿أذاقها﴾ is a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi and a postponed fāʿil; لباس الجوع والخوف is a second object; the bāʾ is a preposition of causation; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), or a relative with the returning pronoun omitted, i.e. "because of their doing" or "because of what they used to do"; ﴿كانوا﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the wāw its noun, and the clause يصنعون its khabar.

muyesser-irab:113-113.t:
﴿ولقد جاءهم رسول منهم فكذبوه﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām occurs in the answer of an implied (muqaddar) oath; قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); جاءهم رسول is a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil (agent); ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رسول; ﴿فكذبوه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and كذبوه is a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فأخذهم العذاب وهم ظالمون﴾: ﴿فأخذهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿فكذبوه﴾; العذاب is the fāʿil; the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and ظالمون a khabar (predicate), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:114-114.t:
﴿فكلوا مما رزقكم الله حلالا طيبا﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (implying an omitted condition); ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كلوا﴾; the clause ﴿رزقكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿حلالًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿كلوا﴾; and طيبًا is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿واشكروا نعمت الله إن كنتم إياه تعبدون﴾: ﴿واشكروا نعمة الله﴾ is an imperative verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi; إن is conditional; كنتم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); كنتم is an incomplete, abrogating past verb and the tāʾ its noun (ism); ﴿إياه﴾ is a fronted object of ﴿تعبدون﴾; and the clause ﴿تعبدون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿كنتم﴾.

muyesser-irab:115-115.t:
﴿إنما حرم عليكم الميتة والدم ولحم الخنزير وما أهل لغير الله به﴾: ﴿إنما﴾ is inna restrained by the restraining mā (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿حرم﴾ is a verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حرم﴾; الميتة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الدم and لحم الخنزير are conjoined to الميتة, and ﴿ما﴾ is also conjoined; the clause ﴿أهل﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿لغير الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أهل﴾.
﴿فمن اضطر غير باغ ولا عاد﴾: the fāʾ is for ramification (tafrīʿ); من is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); اضطر is a past verb in the passive (built for what has not had its agent named), in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, referring back to ﴿مَن﴾; ﴿غير باغ﴾ is a ḥāl; and ﴿لا عاد﴾ is conjoined to ﴿باغ﴾.
﴿فإن الله غفور رحيم﴾: the fāʾ is linking; إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh), the Divine Name its noun (ism), غفور its first khabar (predicate), and رحيم its second khabar; and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

muyesser-irab:116-116.t:
﴿ولا تقولوا لما تصف ألسنتكم الكذب﴾: لا is prohibitive; تقولوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿لما تصف﴾: the lām is a preposition and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun); ﴿ما﴾ together with what it governs is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تقولوا﴾; ﴿ألسنتكم﴾ is the fāʿil of ﴿تصف﴾, and الكذب the object of ﴿تصف﴾; the clause ﴿هذا حلال﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and ﴿وهذا حرام﴾ is conjoined to ﴿هذا حلال﴾; ﴿لتفتروا﴾ is a badal (substitute) from His words ﴿لما تصف﴾; ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تفتروا﴾; and الكذب is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿تفتروا﴾. Or [الكذب is the object] of ﴿تقولوا﴾, the clause ﴿هذا حلال﴾ being a badal from it, and ﴿ما﴾ being a relative, i.e. "and do not say the lie about what your tongues describe, saying: this is unlawful and this is lawful". And it has been said that ﴿الكذب﴾ is a badal from the omitted object of ﴿تصف﴾, i.e. "about what it describes".
﴿إن الذين يفترون على الله الكذب لا يفلحون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh) and الذين its noun (ism); the clause يفترون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يفترون﴾; ﴿الكذب﴾ is the object of ﴿يفترون﴾; and the clause ﴿لا يفلحون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of inna.

muyesser-irab:117-117.t: ﴿متاع قليل ولهم عذاب أليم﴾: متاع is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "that deed, which is their habit, is an enjoyment of little benefit"; or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "for them is an enjoyment"; ﴿قليل﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿متاع﴾; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿عذاب﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and ﴿أليم﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿عذاب﴾.

muyesser-irab:118-118.t:
﴿وعلى الذين هادوا حرمنا ما قصصنا عليك من قبل﴾: ﴿وعلى الذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حرمنا﴾; the clause ﴿هادوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذين﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿قصصنا﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿عليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قصصنا﴾; and ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حرمنا﴾.
﴿وما ظلمناهم ولكن كانوا أنفسهم يظلمون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿ظلمناهم﴾ is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿لكن﴾ is lightened and inoperative, so it is a particle of rectification (istidrāk); ﴿كانوا﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb and the wāw its noun (ism); ﴿أنفسهم﴾ is a fronted object of ﴿يظلمون﴾; and the clause ﴿يظلمون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿كانوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:119-119.t:
﴿ثم إن ربك للذين عملوا السوء بجهالة ثم تابوا من بعد ذلك وأصلحوا﴾: ثم is a conjunction for delay; إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh) and ربك its noun (ism); ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna, i.e. "forgiving to those who…"; ﴿عملوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿السوء﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بجهالة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in ﴿يعملون﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in this ayah is عملوا], i.e. "they did evil in ignorance"; ﴿ثم تابوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿عملوا﴾; ﴿من بعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تابوا﴾, and ﴿ذلك﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿وأصلحوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تابوا﴾.
﴿إن ربك من بعدها لغفور رحيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle and ربك its noun; ﴿من بعدها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿غفور﴾; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); غفور is the khabar of inna, and رحيم a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:120-120.t: ﴿إن إبراهيم كان أمة قانتا لله حنيفا ولم يك من المشركين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh), إبراهيم its noun (ism), and the clause كان its khabar (predicate); the noun of kāna is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa", i.e. Ibrāhīm; ﴿أمة﴾ is the khabar of kāna; ﴿قانتًا﴾ is a second khabar of ﴿كان﴾; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قانتًا﴾; حنيفًا is a third khabar; ﴿ولم يك﴾: لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive, and ﴿يك﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn, and the nūn has been elided for lightness; the noun of ﴿يك﴾ is latent, its implied form being "huwa"; and ﴿من المشركين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿يك﴾.

muyesser-irab:121-121.t: ﴿شاكرا لأنعمه اجتباه وهداه إلى صراط مستقيم﴾: شاكرًا is a fourth khabar (predicate) of ﴿كان﴾; ﴿لأنعمه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿شاكرًا﴾; the clause ﴿اجتباه﴾ is a fifth khabar; ﴿وهداه﴾ is conjoined to ﴿اجتباه﴾; ﴿إلى صراط﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿هداه﴾; and مستقيم is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿صراط﴾.

muyesser-irab:122-122.t: ﴿وآتيناه في الدنيا حسنة وإنه في الآخرة لمن الصالحين﴾: conjoined to what preceded; ﴿آتيناه﴾ is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في الدنيا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حسنة﴾; ﴿حسنة﴾ is a second object; ﴿إنه﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh) and the hāʾ its noun (ism); ﴿في الآخرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿من الصالحين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna.

muyesser-irab:123-123.t:
﴿ثم أوحينا إليك أن اتبع ملة إبراهيم حنيفا﴾: ثم is a conjunction; ﴿أوحينا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحينا﴾; ﴿أن اتبع﴾: أن is explicative, because revelation (waḥy) contains the meaning of saying without its letters, and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, and together with what it governs it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿أوحى﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source, apparently carried over from 16:68; the verb in this ayah is أوحينا]; the clause ﴿اتبع﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. ﴿ملة إبراهيم﴾ is the object of ﴿اتبع﴾, and ﴿حنيفًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿إبراهيم﴾.
﴿وما كان من المشركين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ما is negating; كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, and its noun (ism) is latent (mustatir); ﴿من المشركين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:124-124.t:
﴿إنما جعل السبت على الذين اختلفوا فيه﴾: إنما is inna restrained by the restraining mā (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿جعل﴾ is a past verb in the passive (built for what has not had its agent named); السبت is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿على الذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جعل﴾, so it stands as the second object; the clause ﴿اختلفوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اختلفوا﴾.
﴿وإن ربك ليحكم بينهم يوم القيامة فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and the clause after it conjoined, or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh) and ربك its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause يحكم is the khabar (predicate) of inna; ﴿بينهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يحكم﴾; in ﴿يوم القيامة﴾ the adverb is attached to ﴿يحكم﴾; ﴿فيما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb and the wāw its noun; the clause كانوا is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يختلفون﴾; and the clause ﴿يختلفون﴾ is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:125-125.t:
﴿ادع إلى سبيل ربك بالحكمة والموعظة الحسنة﴾: ادع is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "anta"; the object is omitted, i.e. "people"; ﴿إلى سبيل ربك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ادع﴾; ﴿بالحكمة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "accompanied by it"; and الموعظة الحسنة is conjoined to الحكمة.
﴿وجادلهم بالتي هي أحسن﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; جادلهم is conjoined to ادع, and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بالتي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جادلهم﴾; ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and أحسن a khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿هي أحسن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن ربك هو أعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh) and ربك its noun (ism); ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and أعلم a khabar, and the clause is the khabar of inna; ﴿بمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعلم﴾; the clause ضل is the ṣila of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿عن سبيله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ضل﴾.
﴿وهو أعلم بالمهتدين﴾: ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and أعلم a khabar; ﴿بالمهتدين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعلم﴾.

muyesser-irab:126-126.t:
﴿وإن عاقبتم فعاقبوا بمثل ما عوقبتم به﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; عاقبتم is a past verb and the tāʾ its fāʿil (agent), and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿فعاقبوا﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and عاقبوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; ﴿بمثل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عاقبوا﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause عوقبتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عوقبتم﴾; and the clause ﴿فعاقبوا﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿ولئن صبرتم لهو خير للصابرين﴾: the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); إن is conditional; صبرتم is in the position of the jussive as the protasis; the lām occurs in the answer of the oath because the oath comes first; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿خير﴾ a khabar (predicate); and ﴿للصابرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خير﴾.

muyesser-irab:127-127.t:
﴿واصبر﴾: the wāw is resumptive; اصبر is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause ﴿واصبر﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما صبرك إلا بالله ولا تحزن عليهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; صبرك is a mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the wāw is conjunctive; لا is prohibitive; تحزن is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā; and ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تحزن﴾.
﴿ولا تك في ضيق مما يمكرون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لا is prohibitive; ﴿تكُ﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive by lā, the sign of its jussive being the implied (muqaddar) sukūn on the nūn that has been elided for lightness; the noun (ism) of ﴿تكُ﴾ is latent, its implied form being "anta"; ﴿في ضيق﴾ is the khabar of ﴿تكُ﴾; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) [Translator's note: so in the source, «متعلقان بمحذوف مضاف إليه»]; and the clause ﴿يمكرون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:128-128.t: ﴿إن الله مع الذين اتقوا والذين هم محسنون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh) and the Divine Name its noun (ism); ﴿مع﴾ is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), and الذين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); اتقوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿الذين﴾ is conjoined to ﴿الذين﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and محسنون a khabar, and the clause is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿أتى أمر الله فلا تستعجلوه﴾: أتى is a past verb; أمر الله is its fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تستعجلوه is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; the wāw is the agent; and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿سبحانه وتعالى عما يشركون﴾: سبحانه: standing as deputy for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); تعالى is a past verb; ﴿عما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿سبحانه﴾ or to ﴿تعالى﴾; ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) or relative (mawṣūla); and the clause يشركون has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿ينزل الملائكة بالروح من أمره على من يشاء من عباده﴾: ﴿ينزل الملائكة﴾ is a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بالروح﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿ينزل﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "invested with the Spirit"; ﴿من أمره﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿على من يشاء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينزل﴾; and ﴿من عباده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿أن أنذروا﴾: ﴿أن﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya), because الروح means revelation, and revelation contains the meaning of speech; ﴿أنذروا﴾: an imperative verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿أنذروا﴾ is explicative with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), and the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن أنذروا﴾ is a badal (substitute) from الروح, genitive (majrūr); and the clause ﴿أنذروا﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿أنه لا إله إلا أنا فاتقون﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ is the noun (ism) of أن; the clause ﴿لا إله إلا أنا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أن; ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of generic negation; ﴿إله﴾ is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); ﴿أنا﴾ is a badal from the position of ﴿لا﴾ and its noun; ﴿فاتقون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; اتقون is an imperative verb and agent; the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya); and the yāʾ of the first person has been deleted in keeping with the verse-endings (fawāṣil).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض بالحق تعالى عما يشركون﴾: ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض﴾ is a verb and a latent (mustatir) agent; السماوات is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الأرض is conjoined to السماوات; ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "rightfully"; تعالى is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); ﴿عما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تعالى﴾; and the clause يشركون is a ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿خلق الإنسان من نطفة فإذا هو خصيم مبين﴾: ﴿خلق الإنسان﴾ is a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من نطفة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿خلق﴾, and من is for the starting point (ibtidāʾ); ﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is the [إذا] of surprise (fujāʾiyya); ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); خصيم is the khabar (predicate); and مبين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿والأنعام خلقها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الأنعام is accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb indicated by what follows it. The clause of the omitted verb is conjoined to His saying ﴿خلق الإنسان﴾ in the previous verse. خلقها: a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿خلقها﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya) with no grammatical position.
﴿لكم فيها دفء ومنافع﴾: ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); دفء is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is circumstantial, or resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position. Or ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl of دفء, and ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; and منافع is conjoined to دفء.
﴿ومنها تأكلون﴾: ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تأكلون﴾; and تأكلون is an imperfect verb and fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿ولكم فيها جمال حين تريحون وحين تسرحون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); جمال is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); حين is an adverb attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); the clause تريحون is that to which it is annexed (muḍāf ilayhi); and likewise His saying: ﴿وحين تسرحون﴾.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وتحمل أثقالكم إلى بلد لم تكونوا بالغيه إلا بشق الأنفس﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; تحمل أثقالكم is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿إلى بلد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿تحمل﴾; the clause ﴿لم تكونوا بالغيه﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of بلد; ﴿بالغيه﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of تكونوا; إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); and ﴿بشق الأنفس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nominative pronoun in ﴿بالغيه﴾, i.e. "with hardship upon you".
﴿إن ربكم لرءوف رحيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ربكم is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and رءوف رحيم are two khabars.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿والخيل والبغال والحمير لتركبوها وزينة﴾: ﴿والخيل﴾ and what follows it are conjoined to الأنعام, i.e. "and He created these for riding and adornment"; ﴿لتركبوها﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation (taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an accusative [word that is a] mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); ﴿زينة﴾ is conjoined to the position of ﴿لتركبوها﴾; and it is also said that it is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in ﴿تركبوها﴾.
﴿ويخلق ما لا تعلمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وعلى الله قصد السبيل ومنها جائر﴾: ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿قصد السبيل﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; and جائر is a naʿt (adjective) of a qualified noun which is the postponed mubtadaʾ, i.e. "a deviating way".
﴿ولو شاء لهداكم أجمعين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لو is a conditional [particle] of impossibility (imtināʿiyya); the object of ﴿شاء﴾ is omitted, i.e. "had He willed your guidance"; the lām links (rābiṭa) the apodosis of ﴿لو﴾; هداكم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t: ﴿هو الذي أنزل من السماء ماء لكم منه شراب ومنه شجر فيه تسيمون﴾: ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الذي﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause أنزل is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿من السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to أنزل; ماء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of شراب; شراب is the postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لكم منه شراب﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ماء; ﴿منه شجر﴾ is a resumptive clause (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position, composed of a fronted khabar and a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تسيمون﴾; and the clause تسيمون is a naʿt of شجر.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿ينبت لكم به الزرع والزيتون والنخيل والأعناب ومن كل الثمرات﴾: ينبت is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿ينبت﴾; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينبت﴾, and the bāʾ is causal, i.e. "by means of it the trees grow"; الزرع is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الزيتون, النخيل and الأعناب are conjoined to الزرع; and ﴿من كل الثمرات﴾ is likewise conjoined to what precedes.
﴿إن في ذلك لآية لقوم يتفكرون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿آية﴾ is the postponed noun (ism) of إن; ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية; and the clause يتفكرون is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿وسخر لكم الليل والنهار والشمس والقمر﴾: ﴿وسخر لكم الليل﴾ is a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿سخر﴾; and الشمس and القمر are conjoined to الليل and النهار.
﴿والنجوم مسخرات بأمره﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; النجوم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); مسخرات is the khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined to the previous clause; and ﴿بأمره﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مسخرات﴾.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يعقلون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آيات is the postponed noun (ism) of إن; ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آيات; and the clause يعقلون is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وما ذرأ لكم في الأرض مختلفا ألوانه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is conjoined to ﴿الليل والنهار﴾ in the previous verse; it is also said that it is accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb, i.e. "and He created and caused to grow"; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿ذرأ﴾; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿ذرأ﴾; مختلفًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ألوانه is the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿مختلفًا﴾.
﴿إن في ذلك لآية لقوم يذكرون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آية is the postponed noun (ism) of إن; ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية; and the clause يذكرون is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿وهو الذي سخر البحر لتأكلوا منه لحما طريا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الذي is the khabar (predicate); the clause سخر is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; البحر is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لتأكلوا﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and تأكلوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿سخر﴾; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تأكلوا﴾; لحمًا is the direct object; and طريًّا is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وتستخرجوا منه حلية تلبسونها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; تستخرجوا is conjoined to لتأكلوا; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تستخرجوا﴾; حلية is the direct object; and the clause تلبسونها is a naʿt of ﴿حلية﴾.
﴿وترى الفلك مواخر فيه ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون﴾: the wāw is parenthetical; ترى الفلك: a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a direct object; the clause ﴿وترى الفلك﴾ is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) with no grammatical position; مواخر: a ḥāl (circumstantial), because the seeing is visual; ﴿فيه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مواخر﴾; ﴿لتبتغوا﴾ is conjoined to لتأكلوا; لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the kāf is its noun (ism); and the clause تشكرون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿وألقى في الأرض رواسي أن تميد بكم﴾: ﴿وألقى﴾ is conjoined to ﴿وسخر﴾; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ألقى; رواسي is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "firm mountains"; أن and what falls in its scope is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of aversion to its swaying with you and shaking"; and ﴿بكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تميد﴾.
﴿وأنهارا وسبلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنهارًا and سبلًا are conjoined to رواسي, or are the direct object of an omitted verb, the implied form being: «وجعل فيها» ("and He made in it").
﴿لعلكم تهتدون﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the kāf is its noun (ism); and the clause تهتدون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿وعلامات وبالنجم هم يهتدون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; علامات is conjoined to ﴿رواسي﴾; ﴿بالنجم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يهتدون﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يهتدون﴾ is its khabar (predicate). It is also said that [علامات] is the object of an omitted verb, i.e. "and He placed in it landmarks".

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿أفمن يخلق كمن لا يخلق﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial (istifhām inkārī); the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted; ﴿مَن﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يخلق﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿كمن﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and مَن is a relative noun in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿لا يخلق﴾ is a ṣila of the second ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿أفلا تذكرون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial; the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿تذكرون﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿وإن تعدوا نعمة الله لا تحصوها﴾: a resumptive clause (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; تعدوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); نعمة الله is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لا is negative; تحصوها is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the wāw is the agent; and ﴿ها﴾ is the direct object.
﴿إن الله لغفور رحيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; غفور is the first khabar (predicate) of إن, and رحيم is its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿والله يعلم ما تسرون وما تعلنون﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يعلم is the khabar (predicate); the fāʿil (agent) of يعلم is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause تسرون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿ما تعلنون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما تسرون﴾.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿والذين يدعون من دون الله لا يخلقون شيئا وهم يخلقون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يدعون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿من دون الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿لا يخلقون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of الذين; شيئًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿يخلقون﴾ is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); and the clause ﴿يخلقون﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿أموات غير أحياء وما يشعرون أيان يبعثون﴾: أموات is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); it is also said to be a second khabar of ﴿الذين﴾ in the previous verse; ﴿غير أحياء﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of أموات, intended for emphasis; ﴿ما يشعرون﴾ is conjoined to أموات, or is a third khabar of ﴿الذين﴾; ﴿أيان﴾ is an adverb of ﴿يبعثون﴾, so it is attached (mutaʿalliq) to it; and the wāw refers back to the idols.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿إلهكم إله واحد﴾: إلهكم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إله is the khabar (predicate); and واحد is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿فالذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة قلوبهم منكرة﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; الذين is the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون بالآخرة﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; قلوبهم is a mubtadaʾ; منكرة is the khabar of قلوبهم; and the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين.
﴿وهم مستكبرون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; مستكبرون is the khabar; and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿لا جرم أن الله يعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون﴾: لا is negative; جرم is a past verb; أن and what falls in its scope is its fāʿil (agent); the clause يعلم is the khabar (predicate) of أن; the clause يسرون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿ما يعلنون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما يسرون﴾.
﴿إنه لا يحب المستكبرين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿لا يحب﴾ is its khabar; and المستكبرين is the object of يحب.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿وإذا قيل لهم ماذا أنزل ربكم قالوا أساطير الأولين﴾: إذا is an adverb of future time; the clause ﴿قيل لهم﴾ is that to which the adverb is annexed (muḍāf ilayhi); the clause ﴿ماذا أنزل ربكم﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of ﴿قيل﴾; the speech is resumptive (mustaʾnaf) with no grammatical position; ﴿ماذا﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as the fronted object of أنزل; or ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, and ﴿ذا﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate); ﴿أنزل ربكم﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position; and ﴿أساطير الأولين﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are the tales of the ancients", or: "what was sent down is the tales of the ancients".

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿ليحملوا أوزارهم كاملة يوم القيامة﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl); يحملوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿قالوا﴾; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); أوزارهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); كاملة is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿يوم القيامة﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿يحملوا﴾. It is also said that the lām is for consequence (ʿāqiba).
﴿ومن أوزار الذين يضلونهم بغير علم ألا ساء ما يزرون﴾: ﴿ومن أوزار﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أوزارهم﴾, so the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يحملوا﴾; من is partitive, i.e. "and some of the burdens of those who go astray through their leading astray"; it is also said that it is for the genus, i.e. "so that they bear [something] of the genus of the burdens of the disbelievers"; the clause ﴿يضلونهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿بغير علم﴾ is a ḥāl of the direct object, and it is also said: of the agent to whom the leading astray is attributed; ﴿ألا﴾ is a particle of alerting (tanbīh); ﴿ساء﴾ is a past verb for expressing blame; ﴿ما﴾ is a tamyīz (specification), i.e. "a thing", and the clause ﴿يزرون﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾; or ﴿ما﴾ is the agent of ﴿ساء﴾, and the clause ﴿يزرون﴾ is its ṣila, with no grammatical position; and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "their burden" (وزرهم).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿قد مكر الذين من قبلهم فأتى الله بنيانهم من القواعد﴾: a resumptive clause (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); مكر الذين is a verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿من قبلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿فأتى الله بنيانهم﴾ is a verb, agent and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is conjoined to what precedes; and ﴿من القواعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أتى﴾.
﴿فخر عليهم السقف من فوقهم وأتاهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿خر﴾ is a past verb; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خر﴾; السقف is the agent; ﴿من فوقهم﴾ is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿أتاهم العذاب﴾ is a past verb, a fronted direct object and a postponed agent; ﴿من حيث﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أتاهم﴾; and the clause ﴿لا يشعرون﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿ثم يوم القيامة يخزيهم﴾: ثم is a conjunction; ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يخزيهم﴾; القيامة is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and يخزيهم is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ويقول أين شركائي الذين كنتم تشاقون فيهم﴾: أين is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as an adverb of place, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); شركائي is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of شركائي; the clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause تشاقون is the khabar of كنتم; and ﴿فيهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تشاقون﴾.
﴿قال الذين أوتوا العلم إن الخزي اليوم والسوء على الكافرين﴾: ﴿قال الذين﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أوتوا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); العلم is the second direct object; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الخزي is its noun (ism); اليوم is an adverb attached to الخزي, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) that governs as the verb does; السوء is conjoined to الخزي; and ﴿على الكافرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿الذين تتوفاهم الملائكة ظالمي أنفسهم﴾: الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الكافرين﴾ in the previous verse, or a badal (substitute) from it; the clause ﴿تتوفاهم الملائكة﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position, and the clause is a verb, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and fāʿil (agent); ظالمي أنفسهم is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of تتوفاهم; and أنفسهم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فألقوا السلم ما كنا نعمل من سوء﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ألقوا is conjoined to توفاهم; it is also said that ﴿ألقوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿قال الذين أوتوا العلم﴾; and it is also said that the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause ﴿فألقوا السلم﴾ is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; ﴿ألقوا﴾ is a verb and agent; السلم is the direct object; the clause ﴿ما كنا﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl) of an omitted saying, i.e. "saying"; ﴿ما﴾ is negative; ﴿كنا﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿نعمل﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كنا; من is a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant]; and ﴿سوء﴾ is genitive in form and accusative in position as the direct object.
﴿بلى إن الله عليم بما كنتم تعملون﴾: بلى: a particle of answer, to cancel the negation in their saying ﴿ما كنا نعمل من سوء﴾; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is its noun; عليم is its khabar; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿عليم﴾; the clause ﴿كنتم تعملون﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause تعملون is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿فادخلوا أبواب جهنم خالدين فيها﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; ادخلوا is an imperative verb and fāʿil (agent); أبواب is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); جهنم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); خالدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of ادخلوا; and ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿خالدين﴾.
﴿فلبئس مثوى المتكبرين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); بئس is a past verb for expressing blame; مثوى المتكبرين is the agent; and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "it" (هي).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿وقيل للذين اتقوا ماذا أنزل ربكم قالوا خيرا﴾: ﴿قيل﴾ is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿قيل﴾; the clause ﴿اتقوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿ماذا﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as the fronted object of ﴿أنزل﴾; or ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿ذا﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate); ﴿أنزل ربكم﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); and خيرًا is the object of an omitted verb, i.e. "He sent down good".
﴿للذين أحسنوا في هذه الدنيا حسنة﴾: ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; the clause ﴿أحسنوا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿في هذه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أحسنوا﴾; الدنيا is a badal (substitute); حسنة is the postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿للذين أحسنوا...﴾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) with no grammatical position.
﴿ولدار الآخرة خير﴾: the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); دار الآخرة is the mubtadaʾ; and ﴿خير﴾ is the khabar.
﴿ولنعم دار المتقين﴾: the lām is the lām of inception; ﴿نعم﴾ is a past verb for expressing praise; ﴿دار المتقين﴾ is the agent; and the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, i.e. "it" (هي).

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿جنات عدن يدخلونها﴾: جنات is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); or it is the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ), and so is parsed as a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause ﴿نعم دار المتقين﴾; or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿يدخلونها﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). [Translator's note: the source gives the first option, "the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ", twice.]
﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار لهم فيها ما يشاءون﴾: the clause ﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾ is likewise a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause ﴿لهم فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted third ḥāl [Translator's note: so worded in the source, which calls the clause "a preposition and its genitive noun"; the intent appears to be that the clause ﴿لهم فيها ما يشاءون﴾ is a third ḥāl]; ﴿ما﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿يشاءون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿كذلك يجزي الله المتقين﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "with a recompense like that He recompenses"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; and ﴿يجزي الله المتقين﴾ is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿الذين تتوفاهم الملائكة طيبين﴾: الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿المتقين﴾ in the previous verse, or a badal (substitute) from it; the clause ﴿تتوفاهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الملائكة is the fāʿil (agent); and طيبين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object in ﴿تتوفاهم﴾, i.e. "pure of blemishes".
﴿يقولون سلام عليكم ادخلوا الجنة بما كنتم تعملون﴾: the clause ﴿يقولون﴾ is a ḥāl of الملائكة; سلام is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate); ادخلوا الجنة is an imperative verb, agent and direct object; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ادخلوا﴾; the clause كنتم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause تعملون is the khabar of كنتم. It is also said that ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿هل ينظرون إلا أن تأتيهم الملائكة أو يأتي أمر ربك﴾: هل is an interrogative particle whose meaning is negation; ينظرون is an imperfect verb and fāʿil (agent); إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن﴾ and what falls in its scope is the object of ينظرون; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; and ﴿يأتي أمر ربك﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تأتيهم الملائكة﴾.
﴿كذلك فعل الذين من قبلهم﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), or in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿فعل الذين﴾ is a verb and agent; and ﴿من قبلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وما ظلمهم الله﴾: the wāw is parenthetical; ما is negative; ﴿ظلمهم الله﴾ is a verb, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and agent; and the clause is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) with no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن كانوا أنفسهم يظلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لكن﴾ is lightened, non-governing (muhmala); كانوا is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; the wāw is its noun (ism); the clause يظلمون is its khabar (predicate); ﴿أنفسهم﴾ is the fronted object of His saying ﴿يظلمون﴾; and the clause is conjoined to the parenthetical clause, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿فأصابهم سيئات ما عملوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿أصابهم﴾ is a verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); سيئات is the fāʿil (agent); and ﴿ما﴾ is relative (mawṣūla) or maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).
﴿وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿حاق﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is the agent; the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يستهزئون﴾; and the clause يستهزئون is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿وقال الذين أشركوا لو شاء الله ما عبدنا من دونه من شيء نحن ولا آباؤنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; ﴿قال الذين﴾ is a verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أشركوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿لو﴾ is a conditional [particle] of impossibility (imtināʿiyya); ﴿شاء الله﴾ is a verb and agent, and the object is omitted, i.e. "had He willed other than our way and what issues from us"; ﴿ما﴾ is negative; ﴿عبدنا﴾ is a verb and agent; ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant]; ﴿شيء﴾ is genitive in form and the object of عبدنا in position; ﴿نحن﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the agent of ﴿عبدنا﴾; ﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ﴿لا﴾ is negative; and ﴿آباؤنا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿نحن﴾.
﴿ولا حرمنا من دونه من شيء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿حرمنا﴾ is a verb and agent; ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of ﴿شيء﴾; من is a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant]; and شيء is genitive in form, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative in position.
﴿كذلك فعل الذين من قبلهم﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "those before them did a doing like that doing"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿فعل الذين﴾ is a verb and agent; and ﴿من قبلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
