(الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating; (أنزلنا) like «أرسلنا»; (على) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive; (الكتاب) direct object, accusative; (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (اللام) of reason (taʿlīl); (تبيّن) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām.. and the agent is "you"; (لهم) like the first, attached to (تبيّن); (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as direct object; (اختلفوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the agent; (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (اختلفوا); (الواو) conjunction; (هدى) a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), its governor omitted, its implied form being «أنزلنا» [Note: It is not permissible to conjoin (هدى) to the position of the interpreted maṣdar, because its position is genitive, and the agent differs between the verb «أنزلنا» and the interpreted maṣdar, which is why it was made genitive by the lām — unlike «هدى», whose agent agrees with the agent of the verb; so the conjunction became one of conjoining clauses. This is contrary to the view of al-Zamakhsharī, who permitted conjoining (هدى) to the position of (أن تبيّن), which is the accusative.]; (رحمة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «هدى» by the wāw, accusative; (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «رحمة»; (يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «أنزلنا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the answer to the oath.
The clause «تبيّن ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تبيّن) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (أنزلنا).
The clause «اختلفوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «يؤمنون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of «قوم».

safi-cedvel:65-67.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (أنزل) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is «هو»; (من السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل) [Note: Or to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ماء».]; (ماء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الفاء) conjunction; (أحيا) like «أنزل», and the fatḥa is implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أحيا), and (الباء) is causal; (الأرض) direct object, accusative; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (أحيا); (موتها) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive.. and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative; (في) a preposition; (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ» ...
and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (اللام), the second, for emphasis; (آية) the delayed noun (ism) of «إنّ», accusative; (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, a naʿt (adjective) of «آية»; (يسمعون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «الله أنزل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أنزل ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «أحيا ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «أنزل».
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآية ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يسمعون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of «قوم».
(الواو) conjunction; (إنّ) like the first; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the khabar of «إنّ»; (في الأنعام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the implied khabar, and (في) is causal; (لعبرة) like «لآية»; (نسقيكم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the yāʾ.. and (كم) is a pronoun, direct object, and the agent is "we", for majesty; (من) a preposition and (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (نسقيكم); (في بطونه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «ما».. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (من بين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of (لبنا) [Note: Or to (نسقي), and «من» is for the starting point.]; (فرث) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (دم) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «فرث» by the wāw, genitive; (لبنا) a second direct object, accusative; (خالصا) a naʿt of (لبنا), accusative; (سائغا) a second naʿt, accusative; (للشاربين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (سائغا).
The clause «إنّ لكم.. لعبرة» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «الله أنزل».
The clause «نسقيكم ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
(الواو) conjunction; (من ثمرات) a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar of an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. «ثمر» [Note: Abū Ḥayyān chose to attach it to (تتّخذون), with «منه» repeated for emphasis, and the pronoun is singular in the meaning of "the juice".. Or it is attached to (نسقيكم), mentioned or implied.. And the preposition-phrase may be conjoined to his words (في الأنعام), so it would also be a khabar of (إنّ), i.e. "indeed, in the cattle and from the fruits of the palms there is for you a lesson"..]; (النخيل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الأعناب) conjoined to «النخيل» by the wāw, genitive; (تتّخذون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent; (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تتّخذون); (سكرا) direct object, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (رزقا) conjoined to (سكرا), accusative; (حسنا) a naʿt of (رزقا), accusative; (إنّ في ... يعقلون) like «إنّ في ... يسمعون».
The clause «من ثمرات ... ثمر» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «الله أنزل..».
The clause «تتّخذون..» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of «ثمر» — the implied mubtadaʾ.
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآية» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «يعقلون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of «قوم».

* Morphology:
(فرث): a noun for the eaten things partly digested in the stomach (karish); its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(لبنا): a noun for the well-known food (milk); its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(خالصا): active participle from the triliteral «خلص»; its pattern is فاعل.
(سائغا): active participle from the triliteral «ساغ»; its pattern is فاعل, and in it the weak letter is changed to a hamza because it comes after the alif of فاعل, as with every hollow weak verb.
(الشاربين): plural of «الشارب», active participle from the triliteral «شرب»; its pattern is فاعل.
(سكرا): it is originally the maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb «سكر يسكر», of the bāb «فرح»; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas; then wine, or vinegar, or juice as long as it is sweet, came to be called by it..

safi-cedvel:68-69.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (أوحى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (ربّك) fāʿil (agent), nominative.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إلى النحل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوحى); (أن) an explicative particle [Note: Or maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) governed by «أوحى», or genitive by the preposition «الباء».]; (اتّخذي) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الياء) is an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as agent; (من الجبال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اتّخذي), and (من) is partitive; (بيوتا) direct object, accusative; (الواو) conjunction in both places; (من الشجر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what the first preposition-phrase is attached to, so it is conjoined to it; (من) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to the last verb and conjoined to the first preposition-phrase; (يعرشون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «أوحى ربّك..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «اتّخذي ...» has no grammatical position: explicative.
The clause «يعرشون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
(ثمّ) a conjunction; (كلي) like «اتخذي»; (من كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كلي); (الثمرات) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الفاء) conjunction; (اسلكي) like «اتّخذي»; (سبل) direct object; (ربّك) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi; (ذللا) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (سبلا) [Note: Or of the agent of «اسلكي»..], accusative; (يخرج) an imperfect verb, nominative; (من بطونها) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يخرج), and (ها) is muḍāf ilayhi; (شراب) agent, nominative; (مختلف) a naʿt (adjective) of «شراب», nominative; (ألوانه) the agent of the active participle «مختلف», nominative..
and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar (predicate); (شفاء) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «شفاء» [Note: Or it is the lām of strengthening (lām al-taqwiya), and the noun it governs is accusative in position as the direct object of the maṣdar «شفاء».]. (إنّ في.. يتفكّرون) like «إنّ ... يسمعون» [Note: In verse (65) of this sūra.].
The clause «كلي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «اتّخذي».
The clause «اسلكي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «كلي».
The clause «يخرج.. شراب» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآية ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «فيه شفاء ...» is in the position of nominative as a second naʿt of «شراب».

* Morphology:
(النحل): a generic noun (ism jins), whose singular is «نحلة», pattern فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn; and the pattern of «النحل» is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Subtle point-making (tankīt): in the words of the Exalted «أَنِ اتَّخِذِي مِنَ الْجِبالِ بُيُوتاً»:
This meaning is adorned by the partitive sense of «من», attached to the taking of houses, together with the unrestricted eating; as if the Exalted had entrusted the eating to her appetites and choice and did not restrict her in it, though He restricted her concerning the houses, and she was commanded to take them in some places rather than others, because the benefit of eating, absolutely, lies in relishing what she desires of it, whereas the benefit of houses is not attained in every place. For this meaning «ثم» came in: the difference in the matter between restricting her in taking houses and leaving her unrestricted in partaking of the fruits; as you say: "observe what is lawful in what you eat, then eat whatever you wish", so «ثم» stands in between because of the difference between restriction and freedom.
2- Indefiniteness (tankīr): in the words of the Exalted «فيه شفاء». Its indefiniteness is either to magnify the healing that is in it, or because there is some healing in it; both are possible.
It is reported from the Prophet ﷺ that a man came to him and said: "My brother has a complaint in his stomach." He said: "Go and give him honey to drink." He went, then returned and said: "I gave it to him and it did not help." He said: "Go and give him honey to drink, for Allah has spoken the truth and your brother's stomach has lied." So he gave it to him, and Allah cured him and he recovered.
3- Shift of person (iltifāt): in the words of the Exalted «يخرج من بطونها شراب مختلف ألوانه» to the end of the verse: a shift from address to the third person. Had the speech continued in the first pattern, it would have been said «من بطونك» ("from your bellies"). The speech was turned here from address to the third person only for a benefit, namely that He mentioned to human beings honey, its qualities and its various colours, and informed them that there are many benefits in it for them, in order to draw their attention to it. Had He said «من بطونك», that benefit produced by third-person discourse would have been lost.

* Benefits:
- The "explicative «أن»" is the one occurring after a clause that contains the meaning of saying but not its letters; and there is disagreement among those working in the linguistic sciences as to whether in this verse it is explicative or maṣdar-forming.
The explicative «أن» is in the position of «أي» ("that is"), as in the words of the Exalted: «ما قُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِلَّا ما أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ».
Thus in the command there is the meaning of saying, and a clause came after it.

safi-cedvel:70-73.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (خلقكم) a past verb, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is «هو»; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (يتوفّاكم) like «خلقكم»; (الواو) conjunction; (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate); (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as a delayed mubtadaʾ; (يردّ) an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو», and it is the referring pronoun; (إلى أرذل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يردّ); (العمر) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (اللام) a preposition; (كي) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (لا) negating; (يعلم) an imperfect verb, accusative, and the agent is «هو»; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يعلم); (علم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (شيئا) direct object of the maṣdar «علم» [Note: And the object of «يعلم» is a latent pronoun referring to (شيئا), by way of contention (tanāzuʿ).. The reverse may be valid according to the doctrine of the Kufans.].
The interpreted maṣdar (كي لا يعلم) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (يردّ).
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — abrogating (nāsikh); (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun (ism) of «إنّ», accusative; (عليم) the khabar of «إنّ», nominative; (قدير) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «الله خلقكم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «خلقكم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «يتوفّاكم ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «خلقكم».
The clause «منكم من يردّ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumptive clause,
i.e.: "among you is one who remains sound of body until he dies, and among you is one who is returned ..."
The clause «يردّ ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «لا يعلم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (كي).
The clause «إنّ الله عليم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
(الواو) conjunction; (الله فضّل) like «الله خلقكم»; (بعضكم) direct object, accusative, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (على بعض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فضّل); (الفاء) conjunction; (ما) negating, operating as «ليس»; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of nominative as the noun of «ما»; (فضّلوا) a past verb in the passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma..
and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (رادّي) the khabar of «ما», accusative in position, genitive in form, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ; (رزقهم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (على) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (رادّي); (ملكت) a past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine; (أيمانهم) agent, nominative.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction; (هم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (سواء), which is the khabar, nominative; (الهمزة) for interrogation of disapproval and reproach; (الفاء) conjunction; (بنعمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجحدون) — by its being made to carry the meaning of «يكفرون»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (يجحدون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «الله فضّل..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «إنّ الله عليم».
The clause «ما الذين فضّلوا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «الله فضّل».
The clause «فضّلوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «ملكت أيمانهم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «هم فيه سواء» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «ما الذين فضّلوا» [Note: Or it is a reason for the preceding negative clause, so it has no grammatical position.].
The clause «يجحدون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.: "they associate partners with Him, and so deny His favour" [Note: Or it is resumptive, not conjoined.].
(الواو) conjunction; (الله جعل) like «الله خلقكم»..; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (جعل) [Note: By its being made to carry the meaning of «خلق».. or attached to a second object if it means «صيّر» ("made into").]; (من أنفسكم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جعل) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl of «أزواج».].. and (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (أزواجا) direct object, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (جعل لكم من أزواجكم بنين) like «جعل لكم من أنفسكم أزواجا», and the sign of the accusative in «بنين» is the yāʾ, as it is annexed to the sound masculine plural; (الواو) conjunction; (حفدة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «بنين», accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (رزقكم) like «خلقكم»; (من الطيّبات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (رزقكم); (الهمزة) like the first; (الفاء) conjunction; (بالباطل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤمنون), which is like «يجحدون»; (الواو) conjunction; (بنعمة الله.. يكفرون) like «بنعمة الله يجحدون», and (هم) is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ..
The clause «الله جعل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «الله فضّل..».
The clause «جعل ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «جعل (the second)» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the (first) clause «جعل».
The clause «رزقكم ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «جعل».
The clause «يؤمنون ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.:
"do they disbelieve in Allah, whose affair is this, and believe in falsehood?.." [Note: Or it is resumptive, not conjoined.].
The clause «هم يكفرون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «يؤمنون».
The clause «يكفرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
(الواو) conjunction; (يعبدون) like «يجحدون»; (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of «ما»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (ما) a relative noun [Note: Or a qualified indefinite noun, and the clause after it is a naʿt (adjective) in the position of accusative.] in the position of accusative as direct object; (لا) negating; (يملك) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is «هو», and it is the referring pronoun; (لهم) like «لكم», attached to a ḥāl of (رزقا), which is a direct object, accusative; (من السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of (رزقا) [Note: Or attached to (رزقا) as being a maṣdar.. It may also be attached to the verb «يملك».]; (الأرض) conjoined to «السموات» by the wāw, genitive; (شيئا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, i.e.: "they do not possess any possession, neither little nor much" [Note: Or it is a direct object of the maṣdar (رزقا); al-Suyūṭī made it a badal (substitute) of (رزقا).. and al-Jamal rejected that in his gloss.]; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negating; (يستطيعون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent, and the object is omitted.
The clause «يعبدون ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «يكفرون» [Note: Or it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) of His words «أفبالباطل يؤمنون».]. The clause «لا يملك لهم رزقا..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا يستطيعون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.

* Morphology:
(أرذل): elative noun (ism tafḍīl) from the triliteral «رذل»; its pattern is أفعل.
(حفدة): plural of «حافد», which is one who hastens in service and is quick in obedience — and it is said: a grandchild — a noun on the pattern of the active participle; and the pattern of «حفدة» is فعلة, with two fatḥas.

* Rhetoric:
- Metonymy (kināya): in the words of the Exalted «لِكَيْ لا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْئاً» the speech is a metonymy for the extreme of forgetfulness, i.e. so that he becomes very forgetful, such that if he acquires knowledge of something, he soon forgets it and his knowledge of it vanishes within the hour. He says to you: "Who is this?" and you say: "So-and-so", and not a moment passes before he asks you about him.

* Benefits:
- «لِكَيْ لا يَعْلَمَ».
In this verse two accusative-governing particles are combined, the lām of reason and «كي»; then the negating «لا» follows them, coming between the governor and the imperfect verb it puts in the accusative. Here we note two matters:
The first: that «لا» does not block the governor from its governed word; that is why the verb «يعلم» is accusative. The second: that the governor is «كي», because it is nearer to the verb and more closely attached to it than the lām. There may be other independent views for whoever wishes to delve into the disagreements of the grammarians.

safi-cedvel:74-74.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تضربوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تضربوا); (الأمثال) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun (ism) of «إنّ», accusative; (يعلم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is «هو»; (الواو) conjunction; (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (لا) negating; (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «لا تضربوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: Or it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you wish to liken things, then do not strike likenesses for Allah"..].
The clause «إنّ الله يعلم ...» has no grammatical position: giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يعلم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».
The clause «أنتم لا تعلمون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the reason-giving clause.
The clause «لا تعلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم).

safi-cedvel:75-76.t:
* I'rab:
(ضرب) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (مثلا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (عبدا) a badal (substitute) of (مثلا), accusative; (مملوكا) a naʿt (adjective) of (عبدا), accusative; (لا) negating; (يقدر) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is «هو»; (على شيء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يقدر); (الواو) conjunction; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, conjoined to (عبدا) [Note: Or it is a qualified indefinite noun in the position of accusative, and the clause after it is a naʿt.]; (رزقناه) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn..
and (نا) is a pronoun, agent, and (الهاء) is the direct object; (من) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the verb (رزقنا), on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "from Our presence"; (رزقا) a second direct object, accusative; (حسنا) a naʿt of «رزقا», accusative; (الفاء) conjunction; (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (ينفق) like «يقدر»; (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ينفق); (سرّا) a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, i.e. "secret spending".], accusative; (جهرا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (سرّا) by the wāw, accusative; (هل) an interrogative particle; (يستوون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and (الواو) is the agent; (الحمد) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar (predicate); (بل) a particle of inception carrying the meaning of rectification (istidrāk); (أكثرهم) mubtadaʾ, nominative.. and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لا يعلمون) like «لا تعلمون»..
The clause «ضرب الله..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يقدر على شيء» is in the position of accusative as a second naʿt of (عبدا) [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of (عبدا), because it is qualified.].
The clause «رزقناه ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «هو ينفق ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «هل يستوون» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «الحمد لله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أكثرهم لا يعلمون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يعلمون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أكثرهم).
(الواو) conjunction; (ضرب الله مثلا رجلين) like «ضرب الله مثلا عبدا», and the sign of the accusative of the badal is the yāʾ, as it is a dual; (أحدهما) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (هما) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أبكم) khabar, nominative; (يقدر على شيء) like the first [Translator's note: so in the source, without «لا»; the Quranic text is «لا يقدر على شيء», as the clause list below shows]; (الواو) conjunction; (هو) like the first; (كلّ) khabar, nominative; (على مولاه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كلّ), and the sign of the genitive is the implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (أينما) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (يأت) — or to (يوجّهه), which is an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (الهاء) is a pronoun, direct object, and the agent is «هو»; (لا) negating; (يأت) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the weak letter, and the agent is «هو»; (بخير) a preposition and its genitive noun, and it is attached to (يأت); (هل) an interrogative particle; (يستوي) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the yāʾ, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو», i.e. the mute man; (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, tawkīd (emphasis) of the agent because of the conjunction that follows; (الواو) conjunction; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, conjoined to the latent pronoun that is the agent of «يستوي»; (يأمر) like «يقدر»; (بالعدل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأمر); (الواو) conjunction [Note: Or circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause after it is a ḥāl.]; (هو) a pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (على صراط) a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هو»; (مستقيم) a naʿt of «صراط», genitive.
The clause «ضرب الله (the second)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the (first) clause «ضرب».
The clause «أحدهما أبكم ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption [Note: Or it is a naʿt of «رجلين» in the position of accusative, and the link is the referring pronoun «هما»..].
The clause «لا يقدر على شيء ...» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أحدهما).
The clause «هو كلّ ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «لا يقدر».
The clause «يوجّهه ...» has no grammatical position: giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لا يأت بخير ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «هل يستوي ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «يأمر بالعدل ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «هو على صراط ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.

* Morphology:
(مملوكا): passive participle from the triliteral «ملك»; its pattern is مفعول.
(كلّ): an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from «كلّ يكلّ», of the bāb «ضرب»; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn, and its meaning is "heavy" or "of no benefit".

* Benefits:
- The governing action of the maṣdar:
For the maṣdar (verbal noun) to govern as its verb governs, it is stipulated that it be able to have the verb take its place, either joined with the maṣdar-forming «أن» or with the maṣdar-forming «ما».
The governing of the maṣdar with nunation is the regular rule, because it resembles the verb more than the others, as in «أو إطعام في يوم ذي مسغبة يتيما». Next in order after the nunated one comes "the maṣdar in construct", as in «ولولا دفع الله الناس», then follows the maṣdar not in construct [Translator's note: so in the source], then at the end comes "the maṣdar made definite with «أل»", as in «ضعيف الكناية أعداءه»; «النكاية» is the maṣdar made definite with «أل», and «أعداءه» is the direct object. [Translator's note: the source writes «الكناية» in the example and «النكاية» in the explanation; the well-known verse is «ضعيف النكاية أعداءه» ("weak at harming his enemies").]
We shall speak about the noun of the maṣdar (ism al-maṣdar) and its governing in another place.

safi-cedvel:77-77.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate); (غيب) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the kasra; (الأرض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «السموات» by the wāw, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating, non-operative (muhmala); (أمر) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الساعة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (كلمح) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (البصر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (أو) a conjunction; (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (أقرب) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هو», nominative; (إنّ الله.. قدير) like «إنّ الله عليم» [Note: In verse (70) of this sūra.]; (على كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قدير); (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «لله غيب ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ما أمر.. إلّا كلمح ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «هو أقرب» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the implied khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أمر الساعة».
The clause «إنّ الله ... قدير» has no grammatical position: giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(لمح): a maṣdar (verbal noun) meaning closing the eye or opening it, from «لمح», of the bāb «فتح»; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
- Representation (tamthīl): in the words of the Exalted «وَما أَمْرُ السَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ» it is a representation of the swiftness of its coming, as it was expressed at the opening of the noble sūra by "coming". Al-Zajjāj said: "He did not mean that the Hour comes in the twinkling of an eye; He only described the swiftness of the power to bring it about, because He says to a thing «كُنْ فَيَكُونُ»."

safi-cedvel:78-78.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الله أخرجكم) like «الله خلقكم» [Note: In verse 70 of this sūra.]; (من بطون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أخرجكم); (أمّهاتكم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive.
And (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (لا تعلمون): its i'rab has passed [Note: In verse (74) of this sūra.]; (شيئا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (جعل لكم السمع) like «جعل لكم.. أزواجا» [Note: In verse (72) of this sūra, and the preposition-phrase (لكم) is attached to (جعل) by its being made to carry the meaning of «خلق».]; (الواو) conjunction in both places; (الأبصار، الأفئدة) two nouns conjoined to «السمع» by the two conjunctions, accusative; (لعلّكم) a particle resembling the verb, for hope.. and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun (ism) of «لعلّ»; (تشكرون) like «تعلمون» [Note: From verse number (74).].
The clause «الله أخرجكم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أخرجكم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الله).
The clause «لا تعلمون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object in (أخرجكم).
The clause «جعل ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «أخرجكم».
The clause «لعلّكم تشكرون» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «تشكرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of «لعلّ».

safi-cedvel:79-79.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation; (لم) a particle of negation and jussive; (يروا) an imperfect verb, jussive, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (إلى الطير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يروا), by its being made to carry the meaning of «ينظروا» ("they look"); (مسخّرات) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الطير», accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the kasra; (في جوّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مسخّرات); (السماء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (ما) negating; (يمسكهنّ) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (هنّ) is an attached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (الله) the Name of Majesty, agent, nominative; (إنّ في ... يؤمنون): the i'rab of its counterpart has passed [Note: In verse (65) of this sūra.].
The clause «لم يروا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ما يمسكهنّ إلّا الله ...» is in the position of accusative as a second ḥāl of «الطير» [Note: Or resumptive, with no grammatical position.].
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يؤمنون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

* Morphology:
(جوّ): a noun for what is between the sky and the earth, and other things; its plural is «جواء» and «أجواء»; and the pattern of «جوّ» is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
- «مُسَخَّراتٍ»:
Definition of the sound feminine plural: "it is what is pluralised with an alif and a tāʾ that are both additional"; therefore «قضاة» and «هداة» are not sound feminine plurals, but are broken plurals, because their alif and tāʾ are not additional; likewise their tāʾ is the round tāʾ (marbūṭa), whereas the tāʾ of the feminine plural is the open tāʾ. We shall return to it later when speaking about its conditions.

safi-cedvel:80-82.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (الله جعل ... وجعل.. بيوتا) like «الله جعل لكم من أنفسكم أزواجا» [Note: In verse (72) of this sūra.]; (تستخفّونها) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent), and (ها) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تستخفّونها); (ظعنكم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive.. and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (يوم إقامتكم) like «يوم ظعنكم»; (الواو) conjunction; (من أصوافها) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what (من جلود..) is attached to, so it is conjoined to it; (الواو) conjunction in the three places; (أوبارها، أشعارها) two nouns in construct with the pronoun, conjoined to «أصوافها», genitive like it; (أثاثا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (بيوتا), accusative, i.e. "and He made from their wool.. furnishings"; (متاعا) conjoined to (أثاثا), accusative; (إلى حين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (متاعا) [Note: I.e. "an enjoyment enjoyed for a time".].
The clause «الله جعل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «الله أخرجكم» [Note: In verse (78) of this sūra.].
The clause «جعل ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الله).
The clause «جعل (the second)» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the (first) clause «جعل».
The clause «تستخفّونها ...» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (بيوتا).
(الواو) conjunction; (الله جعل.. جعل.. وجعل لكم سرابيل) like «الله جعل لكم.. أزواجا» [Note: In verse (72) of this sūra.] [Translator's note: the word-by-word sequence does not separately parse «مما خلق ظلالا» and «من الجبال أكنانا», though the clause list below mentions «خلق» and its relative «ما»]; (تقيكم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ.. and (كم) is a pronoun, direct object; (الحرّ) a second direct object, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (سرابيل تقيكم بأسكم) like «سرابيل تقيكم الحرّ».. and the second (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الكاف) a preposition of comparison [Note: Or a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being its adjective.]; (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq whose governor is «يتمّ».. and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (يتمّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is «هو»; (نعمته) direct object, accusative.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (على) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive by the preposition, attached to (يتمّ), and (الميم) is for the masculine plural; (لعلّكم تسلمون) like «لعلّكم تشكرون» [Note: In verse (78) of this sūra.].
The clause «الله جعل لكم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «الله جعل لكم.. سكنا».
The clause «جعل لكم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «خلق» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «جعل لكم (the second)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the (first) clause «جعل».
The clause «وجعل لكم (the third)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the (first) clause «جعل», or the (second). [Translator's note: so in the source, although the first «جعل» clause was given the position of nominative above.]
The clause «تقيكم ...» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of «سرابيل».
The clause «تقيكم (the second)» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of the (second) «سرابيل».
The clause «يتمّ..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لعلّكم تسلمون ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «تسلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of «لعلّ».
(الفاء) conjunction; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (تولّوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ)..
and (الواو) is the agent; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (إنّما) a restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (عليك) like «عليكم», attached to a fronted khabar; (البلاغ) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (المبين) a naʿt of «البلاغ», nominative.
The clause «تولّوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «يتمّ..».
The clause «عليك البلاغ ...» has no grammatical position: a reason for the implied apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), i.e.: "if they turn away, then there is no blame on you"..

* Morphology:
(جلود): plural of «جلد», a non-derived (jāmid) noun for what surrounds the body; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.
(ظعنكم): maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral «ظعن»; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(إقامتكم): the regular maṣdar of the four-letter verb «أقام»; the alif before the last letter has been compensated by a tāʾ at its end, because its verb is hollow weak.
(أصواف): plural of «صوف», a non-derived noun; its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn.
(أوبار): plural of «وبر», a non-derived noun; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(أشعار): plural of «شعر», a non-derived noun; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(أثاث): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) meaning goods; its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(متاع): a non-derived noun — or a maṣdar — its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.. and see verse (36) of al-Baqara.
(أكنان): plural of «كنّ», a noun for a covering; in al-Qāmūs: «الكنّ», with kasra, is the protection and covering of everything, and «الكنّ» is the house; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.
(سرابيل): plural of «سربال», a noun for a shirt or anything worn; its pattern is فعلال, with kasra on the fāʾ.

* Benefits:
- «يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ»:
Ibn Durustawayh said: the lexicographers and most grammarians say that every word whose second letter is a guttural letter (ḥarf ḥalq) may take sukūn or fatḥa, such as «بحر», «نحر», «نهر», «شعر» and «شهر». But we find the poets freeing themselves from this rule out of poetic necessity, and vowelling, when necessary, every word whose middle is quiescent. The curious thing is that we find this licence in the dialects of entire Arab countries, among them Lebanon («اللبنان»): if they want to say «قرش», they say «قرش», and if they say «درب», they vowel the middle and say «درب», and so on with the rest of the nouns with a quiescent middle. [Translator's note: the vowel marks distinguishing the two forms of each example are not shown in the source text.] We do not know whether this is a continuation of, and influence by, the rules of the language, or whether it is the colloquial that has done its work in that.

safi-cedvel:83-83.t:
* I'rab:
(يعرفون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (نعمة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (ينكرونها) like «يعرفون».. and (ها) is a pronoun, direct object; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (أكثرهم) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الكافرون) khabar (predicate), nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «يعرفون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ينكرونها ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أكثرهم الكافرون» is in the position of accusative as an emphasising ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of «ينكرون».

safi-cedvel:84-87.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (يوم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «اذكر» ("remember"); (نبعث) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is "we", for majesty; (من كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نبعث); (أمّة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (شهيدا) direct object, accusative; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (لا) negating; (يؤذن) an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative [Note: What the permission concerns is omitted, i.e. returning to the abode of this world, or speaking and excusing themselves..]; (اللام) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), in the position of nominative; (كفروا) a past verb and its agent; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) like the first; (هم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (يستعتبون) an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative.. and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «نبعث ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the clause of what the adverb is attached to is resumptive.
The clause «لا يؤذن ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «نبعث».
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «هم يستعتبون» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «يؤذن».
The clause «يستعتبون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to the content of the apodosis; (رأى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الّذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as agent; (ظلموا) like «كفروا»; (العذاب) direct object, accusative; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (لا يخفّف) like «لا يؤذن», and the nāʾib fāʿil is «هو», i.e. the punishment; (عنهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يخفّف); (الواو) conjunction; (لا هم ينظرون) like «لا هم يستعتبون».
The clause «رأى الذين ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ظلموا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا يخفّف ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «هو» — i.e. the punishment — and the nominal clause has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition [Note: Because an apodosis clause made of the imperfect is not joined with the fāʾ..].
The clause «هم ينظرون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «ينظرون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا رأى الّذين أشركوا شركاءهم) like «إذا رأى.. العذاب»; (قالوا) like «كفروا»; (ربّنا) the one addressed (munādā), in construct, accusative.. and (نا) is muḍāf ilayhi; (ها) a particle of alerting; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (شركاء) khabar, nominative, and (نا) is like the first; (الّذين) a relative in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of «شركاء»; (كنّا) a defective past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (نا) is a pronoun, the noun (ism) of «كان»; (ندعو) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the (الواو); the agent is "we"; (من دونك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied object of «ندعو», i.e. "we call upon them besides You"..
and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction; (ألقوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents.. and (الواو) is the agent; (إلى) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ألقوا), and it refers to the partners; (القول) direct object, accusative; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of «إنّ»; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (كاذبون) the khabar of «إنّ», nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «رأى الذين ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أشركوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «of the vocative and its answer» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by «قالوا» (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «هؤلاء شركاؤنا ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
The clause «كنّا ندعو ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «ألقوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause that answers the vocative.
The clause «إنّكم لكاذبون» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the maṣdar (القول) [Note: Or it has no grammatical position: explicative.].
(الواو) conjunction; (ألقوا إلى الله.. السلم) like «ألقوا إليهم القول»; (يومئذ): «يوم» is an adverb of time, accusative, attached to the verb «ألقوا».. and (إذ) is an adverbial noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (ضلّ) a past verb; (عنهم) like the first, attached to (ضلّ); (ما) a relative noun [Note: Or it is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is the agent.], indeclinable, in the position of nominative as agent, and the referring pronoun is omitted; (كانوا) a defective past verb.. and (الواو) is the noun of «كان»; (يفترون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «ألقوا.. السلم» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «ألقوا.. القول».
The clause «ضلّ عنهم ما ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «ألقوا السلم».
The clause «كانوا يفترون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يفترون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كانوا».

safi-cedvel:88-89.t:
* I'rab:
(الّذين) a relative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (كفروا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (الواو) conjunction; (صدّوا) like «كفروا»; (عن سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (صدّوا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (زدناهم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn..
and (نا) is a pronoun, agent, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عذابا) a second direct object, accusative; (فوق) an adverb of place, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (عذابا); (العذاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (كانوا يفسدون) like «كانوا يفترون» [Note: In the preceding verse (87).].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا يفسدون) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (زدناهم).
The clause «الّذين كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «صدّوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «زدناهم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الّذين).
The clause «كانوا يفسدون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «يفسدون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كانوا».
(الواو) conjunction; (يوم نبعث.. شهيدا): its i'rab has passed [Note: In verse (84) of this sūra.]; (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (شهيدا); (من أنفسهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of (شهيدا), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (جئنا) like «زدنا»; (الباء) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (جئنا); (شهيدا) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the second-person pronoun, accusative; (على) a preposition; (ها) a particle of alerting; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to the second (شهيدا); (الواو) resumptive; (نزّلنا) like «زدنا»; (عليك) like «عليهم», attached to (نزّلنا); (الكتاب) direct object, accusative; (تبيانا): a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative [Note: Or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl, i.e. «مبنيّين» ... — Translator's note: so in the source; «مبيّنين» ("clarifying") is evidently meant.]; (لكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تبيانا); (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction in the three places; (هدى، رحمة، بشرى) nouns conjoined to «التبيان» by the conjunctions, accusative like it, and the sign of the accusative in «هدى» and «بشرى» is the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (للمسلمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بشرى), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «نبعث ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «جئنا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «نبعث».
The clause «نزّلنا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(تبيانا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the four-letter verb «بيّن»; it seems that there is no maṣdar on this pattern other than this one along with the maṣdar «تلقاء».. As for nouns, they are many, like «التمساح» and «التمثال».. Its pattern is تفعال, with kasra on the tāʾ.

safi-cedvel:90-90.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun (ism) of «إنّ», accusative; (يأمر) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is «هو»; (بالعدل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يأمر); (الواو) conjunction in the five places; (الإحسان، إيتاء) two nouns conjoined to «العدل», genitive; (ذي) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ; (القربى) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif; (ينهى) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the alif, and the agent is «هو»; (عن الفحشاء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينهى); (المنكر، البغي) two nouns conjoined to «الفحشاء» by the two conjunctions, genitive; (يعظكم) like «يأمر».. and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لعلّكم) a particle resembling the verb, for hope.. and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of «لعلّ»; (تذكّرون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «إنّ الله يأمر ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يأمر ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».
The clause «ينهى ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «يأمر».
The clause «يعظكم ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of «يأمر» and «ينهى».
The clause «لعلّكم تذكّرون ...» has no grammatical position: giving a reason (taʿlīliyya) [Note: Or it has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).].
The clause «تذكّرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of «لعلّ».

* Morphology:
(إيتاء): the regular maṣdar (verbal noun) of the four-letter verb «آتى», since its pattern is أفعل; the origin of «إيتاء» is «إئتاء»: the second hamza was lightened, and the final yāʾ was changed into a hamza because a quiescent alif comes before it.

* Rhetoric:
1- This verse — as al-Bukhārī reported in al-Adab, al-Bayhaqī in Shuʿab al-Īmān, and al-Ḥākim, who declared it sound, from Ibn Masʿūd — is the most comprehensive verse for good and evil, and it was the cause of faith becoming settled in the heart of ʿUthmān ibn Maẓʿūn. More than one has said: if there were nothing in the Qur'an but this noble verse, it would suffice for its being "a clarification of everything" and guidance.
2- It in fact contains varieties of eloquence, which we explain in what follows:
a- Concision (ījāz): at the beginning of the verse He commanded every good, after that He forbade every evil, and He sealed the verse with the most eloquent of admonitions, and He framed that in the endings of the phrases.
b- Soundness of division (ṣiḥḥat al-taqsīm): in it He covered all the divisions of the meaning, so no good remains but it falls within the scope of the command, and no evil remains but it falls within the domain of the prohibition. He put the mention of justice first because it is obligatory, and followed it with excellence (iḥsān) because it is recommended, so that the arrangement of the speech would be in the best order.
c- Excellence of sequence (ḥusn al-nasaq): in the ordering of the clauses and the conjoining of some to others as is fitting, since He put justice first and conjoined excellence to it, «الإحسان» being a general noun while giving to relatives is specific, as though it were a species of that genus; then He brought the clause of command first and conjoined the clause of prohibition to it.
d- Excellence of clarity (ḥusn al-bayān): because whoever hears the wording of the verse does not hesitate in understanding its meaning, since it is free of complexity in its wording and indicates its meaning clearly by the nearest and easiest of ways, and the clever and the dull are equal in understanding it.

safi-cedvel:91-92.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (أوفوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn..
and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (بعهد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوفوا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis; (عاهدتّم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (تم) is a pronoun, agent; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تنقضوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn, and (الواو) is the agent; (الأيمان) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تنقضوا); (توكيدها) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.. and (ها) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl; (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (جعلتم) like «عاهدتم»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, direct object, accusative; (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (كفيلا), by its being made to carry the meaning of «شاهدا» ("witness"); (كفيلا) a second direct object, accusative; (إنّ الله بعلم) like «إنّ الله يأمر» [Note: In the preceding verse (90).] [Translator's note: so in the source («بعلم»); the Quranic text is «إنّ الله يعلم», as the clause list below shows]; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of accusative as direct object, and the clause after it is the ṣila, and the referring pronoun is omitted, i.e. «تفعلونه».]; (تفعلون) like «تذكّرون» [Note: In verse (90).].
The clause «أوفوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «عاهدتّم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what was mentioned before it.
The clause «لا تنقضوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «جعلتم ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of «تنقضوا».. [Note: Or of the agent of the maṣdar (توكيد), even though it is omitted.].
The clause «إنّ الله يعلم ...» has no grammatical position: in the status of giving a reason.
The clause «يعلم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».
The clause «تفعلون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما).
(الواو) conjunction; (لا) like the first; (تكونوا) a defective imperfect verb, jussive, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is a pronoun, the noun (ism) of «تكون»; (الكاف) a preposition of comparison; (التي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to the khabar of «تكونوا»; (نقضت) a past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine; (غزلها) direct object, accusative.. and (ها) is muḍāf ilayhi, and the agent is «هي», the referring pronoun [Translator's note: the source has «هو»]; (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نقضت); (قوّة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (أنكاثا) a ḥāl of «غزلها», accusative [Note: On the view of al-Zajjāj it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because the meaning of «نقضت» is «نكثت», so it matches its governor in meaning.]; (تتّخذون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent; (أيمانكم) direct object, accusative.. and (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (دخلا) a second direct object, accusative; (بينكم) an adverb, accusative, attached to (دخلا), and (كم) is like the first; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (تكون) a defective imperfect verb, accusative; (أمّة) the noun of «تكون», nominative; (هي) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: The Basrans did not permit making (هي) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), because (أمّة) is indefinite.]; (أربى) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هي», nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; (من أمّة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أربى); (إنّما) a restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (يبلوكم) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (كم) is a pronoun, direct object; (الله) the Name of Majesty, agent, nominative; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يبلوكم); (الواو) resumptive; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (يبيّننّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative, and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو», i.e. Allah; (لكم) like «عليكم», attached to (يبيّننّ); (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يبيّننّ); (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as direct object; (فيه) like «به», attached to (تختلفون); (كنتم) a defective past verb and its noun; (تختلفون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent..
The clause «لا تكونوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «لا تنقضوا..».
The clause «نقضت ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (التي).
The clause «تتّخذون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun of «تكونوا».
The clause «تكون أمّة ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تكون..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. «لأن تكون..», and the preposition is attached to the verb «تتّخذون».
The clause «هي أربى ...» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «تكون».
The clause «يبلوكم الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يبيّننّ لكم» has no grammatical position: the answer to an implied oath.
The clause «كنتم فيه تختلفون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «تختلفون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كنتم».

* Morphology:
(توكيد): the regular maṣdar (verbal noun) of the four-letter verb «وكّد»; its pattern is تفعيل.
(كفيلا): an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from «كفل يكفل», of the bāb «فرح»; its pattern is فعيل.
(غزلها): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the triliteral verb «غزل»; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(أنكاثا): plural of «نكث», meaning «منكوث», i.e. "undone"; and «النكث» is with kasra on the nūn, like «حمل» and «أحمال».
(دخلا): a noun for what enters into a thing and is not part of it, i.e. a defect; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(أربى): an elative noun (ism tafḍīl) from «ربا يربو»; its pattern is أفعل, and in it there is a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by substitution; its origin is «أربي» — with fatḥa on the bāʾ — the yāʾ, vowelled after a fatḥa, was changed into an alif, and it is written in the form of a yāʾ because it is the fourth letter, its origin being a wāw.

* Benefits:
- The parable (mathal) in the Qur'an:
We alluded to this Quranic characteristic earlier, and we return to speak about it because of its importance in conveying the message and delivering the call.
It seems that Allah preferred this style of striking parables over others because He, glorified be He, knows the effect it has on the hearts and minds of the listeners.
There comes to mind here the method of the Messiah, upon him be peace, in conveying his message: he took the parable as one of his major means, and he would relate parables to his disciples and followers. It seems that this style took hold of people's hearts, so they would ask him for more of it, listen to him and benefit from what they heard.. We hardly find a sūra in the Noble Qur'an in which there do not occur parables that dazzle and render incapable.
Let us listen to the Exalted in this verse when He says: «وَلا تَكُونُوا كَالَّتِي نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَها مِنْ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنْكاثاً».
In it there is wisdom, a lesson, and an affirmation. As for the science of rhetoric, the parable is a representational simile (tashbīh tamthīlī), because the point of similarity in it is drawn from several attributes.

safi-cedvel:93-93.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (شاء) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (اللام) connecting the apodosis; (جعلكم) like «شاء», and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the agent is «هو»; (أمّة) a second direct object, accusative; (واحدة) a naʿt (adjective) of «أمّة», accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk); (يضلّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is «هو»; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as direct object; (يشاء) like «يضلّ»; (الواو) conjunction; (يهدي من يشاء) like its counterpart; (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) the lām of the oath; (تسألنّ) an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the retention of the nūn, which has been dropped because of the succession of identical letters, and the wāw — dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents — is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis; (عن) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تسألنّ) [Note: Or it is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive, attached to (تسألنّ).]. (كنتم تعملون) like «كنتم تختلفون» [Note: In verse (92) of this sūra.].
The clause «شاء ... الله» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «جعلكم....» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يضلّ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (من).
The clause «يهدي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «يضلّ».
The (second) clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (من).
The clause «تسألنّ ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the implied oath.
The clause «كنتم تعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «تعملون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of «كنتم».

safi-cedvel:94-96.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لا تتّخذوا.. بينكم): the i'rab of its counterpart has passed [Note: In verse (91) of this sūra.]. (الفاء) the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya); (تزلّ) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the fāʾ; (قدم) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تزلّ); (ثبوتها) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تزلّ ...) is in the position of nominative, conjoined to an implied preceding maṣdar, i.e. "let there not be from you a taking of oaths, and so a slipping of a foot".
(الواو) conjunction; تذوقوا [Translator's note: so in the source, without parentheses] an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (تزلّ), and the sign of the accusative is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent; (السوء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (صددتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn..
and (تم) is the agent; (عن سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (صددتم); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما صددتم..) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (تذوقوا).
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar (predicate); (عذاب) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (عظيم) a naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب», nominative.
The clause «لا تتّخذوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. [Translator's note: the source reads «جملة: «جملة لا تتّخذوا ...»», repeating the word «جملة».]
The clause «تزلّ قدم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «تذوقوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause that is the ṣila of the particle relative.
The clause «صددتم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «لكم عذاب ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
(الواو) conjunction; (لا تشتروا) like «لا تنقضوا» «1»; (بعهد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تشتروا) by its being made to carry the meaning of «تستبدلوا» ("exchange"); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (ثمنا) direct object, accusative; (قليلا) a naʿt of (ثمنا), accusative; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the noun (ism) of «إنّ» «2»; [Translator's note: the footnote markers «1» and «2» appear in the source, but their footnote texts are not included in this entry.] (عند) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila of «ما»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, like the first; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (خير) khabar, nominative; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (خير); (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (كنتم) a defective past verb, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) is a pronoun, the noun of «كان»; (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «لا تشتروا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «لا تتّخذوا..».
The clause «إنّ ما عند الله ...» has no grammatical position: giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «هو خير لكم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of «إنّ».
The clause «كنتم تعلمون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تعلمون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كنتم».
(ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (عندكم) like the first, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ينفد) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is «هو», and it is the referring pronoun; (الواو) conjunction; (ما عند الله) like «ما عندكم»; (باق) the khabar of the second «ما», nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the dropped yāʾ, as it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ); (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (نجزينّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative.. and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and the agent is "we", for majesty; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as direct object; (صبروا) a past verb and its agent; (أجرهم) a second direct object, accusative, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (بأحسن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نجزينّ); (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive, and the referring pronoun is omitted, and the clause is the ṣila.]; (كانوا يعملون) like «كنتم تعملون» [Note: In verse (93) of this sūra.].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا..) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ما عندكم ينفد ...» has no grammatical position: in the status of giving a reason for what preceded.
The clause «ينفد ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of «ما».
The clause «ما عند الله باق» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the reason-giving clause «ما عندكم».
The clause «نجزينّ ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the implied oath.
The clause «صبروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «كانوا يعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «يعملون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كانوا».

* Morphology:
(باق): active participle from the triliteral (بقي); its pattern is فاع; its final radical (lām) has been dropped in keeping with the nunation, so it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ).

* Rhetoric:
1- Representational metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya): in the words of the Exalted «فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِها». The speech is a metaphor for falling into a grave matter, because when the foot slips, a person is overturned from a state of good to a state of evil.
(2) And in the words of the Exalted «فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِها»:
The singular and indefinite form of «القدم»: the secret in that is to regard as grave that a single foot should slip from the path of truth after it had been firm upon it — so how about many feet?

safi-cedvel:2-2.t:
* I'rab:
(ينزّل): an imperfect verb, nominative; the agent is a latent pronoun (huwa). (الملائكة): direct object (mafʿūl bihi), accusative. (بالروح): a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl (circumstantial) from الملائكة, i.e. accompanied by revelation [Note: The interpretation of الروح has come up: revelation, the Qur'an, the spirits of creatures, mercy, guidance, Jibrīl, etc.]. (من أمره): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a ḥāl from الروح [Note: or attached to (ينزّل), with من denoting partitiveness.], and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (على): a preposition. (من): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) in the position of a genitive, attached to (ينزّل). (يشاء): like ينزّل. (من عباده): a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl from the relative noun, and (الهاء) is the muḍāf ilayhi. (أن): a maṣdar particle [Note: or a particle of explanation, because the sending down is a revelation that contains the sense of speech, though not its letters.]. (أنذروا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn, and (الواو) is the agent. (أنّ): a particle of emphasis and accusative, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the accusative, the noun of anna. (لا): the lā of generic negation. (إله): the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of the accusative; the khabar of lā is omitted, its implied form being "موجود" ("existent"). (إلّا): a particle of exception. (أنا): a detached pronoun, indeclinable in the position of the nominative, badal (substitute) for the latent pronoun in the khabar.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أنذروا ... ) is in the position of the genitive, badal for الروح.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّه لا إله إلّا أنا..) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. "بأنه لا إله إلّا أنا..", attached to (أنذروا..).
(الفاء): linking the apodosis of an implied condition. (اتّقون): like أنذروا, and (النون) is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and (الياء), which is omitted, is the direct object.
The clause «ينزّل ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «يشاء ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «أنذروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «لا إله إلّا أنا» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of anna.
The clause «اتّقون» has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if the matter is as mentioned, with the angels descending upon the prophets, then fear Me" [Note: or: "if you wish salvation in the Hereafter, then fear Me through My oneness."].

safi-cedvel:3-3.t:
* I'rab:
(خلق): a past verb; the agent is a latent pronoun (huwa). (السموات): direct object, accusative, its accusative marker being the kasra. (الأرض): conjoined (maʿṭūf) with السموات by the wāw, accusative. (بالحقّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl from the agent of خلق. (تعالى عمّا يشركون): its i'rab has been given before [Note: in verse (1) of this sūra.].
The clause «خلق ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause «تعالى ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause «يشركون ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun or of the particle-relative (ما).

safi-cedvel:115-115.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّما) kāffa (restrictive) and makfūfa (restricted) [Translator's note: i.e. inna with the redundant mā that restrains it from governing] (حرّم) a past verb, and the agent is "he" (هو) (على) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (حرّم), (الميتة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (الواو) a conjunction in all four places (الدم، لحم) two nouns conjoined to الميتة, accusative (الخنزير) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to الميتة by the wāw (أهلّ) a past passive verb, indeclinable, and the deputy agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he", and it is the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) (لغير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أهلّ) (الله) the sacred Name, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أهلّ) [Note: or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the deputy agent, i.e. "offered in sacrifice with it".] (الفاء) a conjunction (من) a conditional noun that jussively governs, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject) (اضطرّ) a past passive verb, indeclinable, in the position of the jussive, being the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the deputy agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (غير) ḥāl, accusative (باغ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the implied kasra on the omitted yāʾ (الواو) a conjunction (لا) redundant, to emphasise the negation (عاد) like باغ and conjoined to it (الفاء) a linking fāʾ, or one of causation (إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative (الله) the sacred Name, the noun of inna, accusative (غفور) khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (رحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «إنّما حرّم ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «أهلّ لغير ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «من اضطرّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.
The clause «اضطرّ ... » is in the position of the nominative, as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: it is permissible that the khabar be the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis together.].
The clause «إنّ الله غفور» has no grammatical position; it gives the reason for the implied apodosis, i.e.: "so there is no sin upon him, for Allah is Forgiving…"

* Benefits:
- His saying, the Exalted: ﴿فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ باغٍ وَلا عادٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾.
The jurists said, in substance: if famine befalls a people so that they are on the verge of perishing, and they find nothing to sustain them except one of the prohibited things mentioned in the verse just cited, there is no sin upon them in partaking of what has been explicitly forbidden, provided that they do not take too much of it. They take only what rescues them from destruction; they do not hoard, nor store up, nor keep for themselves, nor add beyond necessity. This is the meaning of his saying: "neither desiring nor transgressing".

safi-cedvel:116-117.t:
* I'rab:
